        auto* raw = core.release();
        const auto handle = engine->registerDSPHandleForRuntime (raw);
        if (handle.isNull())
        {
            DeferredPublicationTestAccess::destroyCoreNodeWithoutRetire (raw);
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V2-1] FAIL: handle registration failed\n");
            return false;
        }

        std::uint64_t id = 0;
        {
            auto pin = engine->tryPinDSPHandle (handle);
            if (! static_cast<bool>(pin))
            {
                // ★ 登録は成功しているが pin が取れない場合、raw は台帳が保有している。
                //   そのまま return すると fixture の teardown でも解放されずリークする。
                //   teardown と同じ順（台帳解除 → 実体破棄）で戻す。
                (void) engine->retireDSPHandleForRuntime (raw);
                DeferredPublicationTestAccess::destroyCoreNodeWithoutRetire (raw);
                std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V2-2] FAIL: could not pin\n");
                return false;
            }
            if (AudioEngine::destroyDSPCoreNodeRetryable (raw) != DestroyOutcome::Deferred)
            {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V2-3] FAIL: defer failed\n");
                return false;
            }

            // ここから観測を開始する（最初の Deferred は数えない）。識別子はここで発行する。
            id = convo::testobs::setTarget (raw);

            // pin 残留のまま再試行 → Deferred と在住 1。
            // ★ 戻り値（破棄した件数）も表明する。Deferred を返せだけで破棄している
            //   実装は 0 を返すので、observer が破棄を記録していてもここで検出できる。
            const std::size_t pinnedRetried = ShutdownHoldTestAccess::retryDeferred (*engine);
            if (pinnedRetried != 0u)
            {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V2-4b] FAIL: pinned retry reported %zu destroyed (want 0)\n",
                             pinnedRetried);
                ok = false;
            }
            const auto held = readDeferredObservation();
            if (held.id != id || held.attempts != 1u || held.deferred != 1u
                || held.destroyed != 0u || held.released)
            {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V2-4] FAIL: pinned retry not observed "
                                     "(id=%llu attempts=%u deferred=%u destroyed=%u released=%d)\n",
                             static_cast<unsigned long long> (held.id),
                             static_cast<unsigned> (held.attempts),
                             static_cast<unsigned> (held.deferred),
                             static_cast<unsigned> (held.destroyed),
                             held.released ? 1 : 0);
                ok = false;
            }
            if (ShutdownHoldTestAccess::deferredResident (*engine) != 1u)
            {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V2-5] FAIL: resident != 1 while pinned\n");
                ok = false;
            }
        }

        // pin 解放後の再試行 → Destroyed と解放経路。
        const std::size_t unpinnedRetried = ShutdownHoldTestAccess::retryDeferred (*engine);
        if (unpinnedRetried != 1u)
        {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V2-6b] FAIL: unpinned retry reported %zu destroyed (want 1)\n",
                         unpinnedRetried);
            ok = false;
        }
        const auto done = readDeferredObservation();
        if (done.id != id || done.attempts != 2u || done.destroyed != 1u || ! done.released)
        {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V2-6] FAIL: unpinned retry not observed "
                                 "(id=%llu attempts=%u destroyed=%u released=%d)\n",
                         static_cast<unsigned long long> (done.id),
                         static_cast<unsigned> (done.attempts),
                         static_cast<unsigned> (done.destroyed),
                         done.released ? 1 : 0);
            ok = false;
        }
        if (ShutdownHoldTestAccess::deferredResident (*engine) != 0u)
        {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V2-7] FAIL: resident != 0 after the unpinned retry\n");
            ok = false;
        }

        // 解放経路で観測対象が外れていること（アドレス再利用の前に解除される）。
        if (convo::testobs::hasTarget())
        {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V2-7b] FAIL: target was not cleared by the release path\n");
            ok = false;
        }

        // 観測を解除する（解放済みポインタを保持し続けない）。
        convo::testobs::clearTarget();
        if (convo::testobs::hasTarget())
        {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V2-8] FAIL: observation target was not cleared\n");
            ok = false;
        }

        if (ok)
            std::printf ("[DQ-V2] positive control: PASS (pinned retry -> Deferred, resident 1; "
                         "unpinned retry -> Destroyed, released)\n");
    }

    // (2) 陰性対照: hold 経路（非静止）では再試行が呼ばれない。
    //   ★ 「再試行 0 回」は、hold 経路を通らずに破棄された場合でも成立する。
    //   実際に hold 経路（非静止 → 基盤をプロセス寿命へ移す）を通ったことを、
    //   DIAG に依存しないプロセス定数で確かめる。
    const int abandonedBeforeHold = ShutdownHoldTestAccess::abandonedReaderSubstrates();
    const int overflowsBeforeHold = ShutdownHoldTestAccess::abandonedSubstrateOverflows();
    // ★ 保持の理由が admission であることを見分けるため、publisher と admission の
    //   idle 失敗回数を前後で比べる。publisher のタイムアウトでも同じ保持になる。
    const int publisherFailuresBeforeHold = AudioEngine::shutdownPublisherIdleFailuresForTest();
    const int admissionFailuresBeforeHold = AudioEngine::shutdownReaderAdmissionIdleFailuresForTest();
    std::uint32_t destroyedTotalBefore = 0;
    std::size_t deferredBefore = 0;
    std::uint64_t id = 0;

    {
        auto engine = std::make_unique<AudioEngine>();
        ShutdownHoldTestAccess::setShutdownWaitTimeout (*engine, 50);
        // ★ 保持の理由は admission。publisher は idle なので、タイムアウトしない予算を与える。
        //   admission 側は 50 ms のままで、意図的な待機を長引しない。
        ShutdownHoldTestAccess::setShutdownPublisherWaitTimeout (*engine, 5000);

        if (ShutdownHoldTestAccess::reserveReaderAdmission (*engine, "deferred") < 0)
        {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V2-9] FAIL: admission reservation failed\n");
            return false;
        }

        auto core = convo::aligned_make_unique<AudioEngine::DSPCore>();
        auto* raw = core.release();
        const auto handle = engine->registerDSPHandleForRuntime (raw);
        if (handle.isNull())
        {
            DeferredPublicationTestAccess::destroyCoreNodeWithoutRetire (raw);
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V2-10] FAIL: handle registration failed\n");
            return false;
        }

        {
            auto pin = engine->tryPinDSPHandle (handle);
            if (! static_cast<bool>(pin))
            {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V2-11] FAIL: could not pin\n");
                return false;
            }
            if (AudioEngine::destroyDSPCoreNodeRetryable (raw) != DestroyOutcome::Deferred)
            {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V2-12] FAIL: defer failed\n");
                return false;
            }
        }

        deferredBefore = ShutdownHoldTestAccess::deferredResident (*engine);
#if CONVOPEQ_ENABLE_RUNTIME_DIAGNOSTICS
        destroyedTotalBefore = convo::diag::registry().totals().destroyedTotal;
#endif

        if (deferredBefore != 1u)
        {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V2-13] FAIL: defer resident=%zu (expected 1)\n",
                         deferredBefore);
            return false;
        }

        // 観測を開始する。引き続き admission を保持し、~AudioEngine は hold 経路を選ぶ。
        id = convo::testobs::setTarget (raw);
    }

    // ★ hold 経路が実行されたこと（非静止で基盤がプロセス寿命へ移された）。
    {
        const int abandonedAfterHold = ShutdownHoldTestAccess::abandonedReaderSubstrates();
        const int overflowsAfterHold = ShutdownHoldTestAccess::abandonedSubstrateOverflows();
        const bool holdPathRan = (abandonedAfterHold == abandonedBeforeHold + 1)
                              || (overflowsAfterHold == overflowsBeforeHold + 1);
        if (! holdPathRan)
        {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V2-13b] FAIL: teardown did not take the admission-hold path "
                                 "(abandoned %d -> %d, overflow %d -> %d)\n",
                         abandonedBeforeHold, abandonedAfterHold,
                         overflowsBeforeHold, overflowsAfterHold);
            ok = false;
        }
        // ★ 保持の理由が admission であること。
        if (AudioEngine::shutdownReaderAdmissionIdleFailuresForTest() == admissionFailuresBeforeHold)
        {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V2-13c] FAIL: admission idle failure did not increase "
                                 "(hold was not caused by the held admission)\n");
            ok = false;
        }
        if (AudioEngine::shutdownPublisherIdleFailuresForTest() != publisherFailuresBeforeHold)
        {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V2-13d] FAIL: publisher idle timed out during teardown "
                                 "(failures %d -> %d)\n",
                         publisherFailuresBeforeHold,
                         AudioEngine::shutdownPublisherIdleFailuresForTest());
            ok = false;
        }
    }

    const auto held = readDeferredObservation();
    if (held.id != id)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V2-14] FAIL: observation id changed (%llu != %llu)\n",
                     static_cast<unsigned long long> (held.id),
                     static_cast<unsigned long long> (id));
        ok = false;
    }
    if (held.attempts != 0u)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V2-15] FAIL: retry was called in the hold path (%u times)\n",
                     static_cast<unsigned> (held.attempts));
        ok = false;
    }
    if (held.deferred != 0u || held.destroyed != 0u || held.released)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V2-16] FAIL: deferred core was touched in the hold path "
                             "(deferred=%u destroyed=%u released=%d)\n",
                     static_cast<unsigned> (held.deferred),
                     static_cast<unsigned> (held.destroyed),
                     held.released ? 1 : 0);
        ok = false;
    }

    // 観測を解除する。
    convo::testobs::clearTarget();
    if (convo::testobs::hasTarget())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V2-17] FAIL: observation target was not cleared\n");
        ok = false;
    }

#if CONVOPEQ_ENABLE_RUNTIME_DIAGNOSTICS
    const auto destroyedTotalAfter = convo::diag::registry().totals().destroyedTotal;
    if (destroyedTotalAfter != destroyedTotalBefore)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V2-18] FAIL: destroyedTotal changed in the hold path (%u -> %u)\n",
                     static_cast<unsigned> (destroyedTotalBefore),
                     static_cast<unsigned> (destroyedTotalAfter));
        ok = false;
    }
#endif

    if (ok)
        std::printf ("[DQ-V2] deferred DSPCore hold: PASS (resident=%zu before teardown, "
                     "retry attempts=0, released=false)\n", deferredBefore);
    return ok;
}



//==============================================================================
// ★ WORK113 (2026-11-18 Owner 指示 / 検証単位): proof 不成立時の drain end-to-end。
//   producer 未 join（bare engine）のため quiescence proof は発行できない。
//   この検証が見るのは、proof の取得が不成立して checked drain が
//   **capability 生成より前に停止する経路** である。
//   tryMakeDrainCapability() の !proof.valid() 分岐を実行したわけではない（Owner 2026-11-18 指摘）。
//==============================================================================
bool checkProofUnavailableKeepsOwnership()
{
    bool ok = true;

    static std::atomic<int> deletes { 0 };
    static int sentinel = 0;
    auto del = [](void*) noexcept { deletes.fetch_add (1, std::memory_order_relaxed); };
    deletes.store (0);

    auto engine = std::make_unique<AudioEngine>();
    auto* domainPtr = ShutdownHoldTestAccess::epochDomainPtr (*engine);
    if (domainPtr == nullptr)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V3-1] FAIL: domain is null\n");
        return false;
    }

    if (! domainPtr->enqueueRetire (&sentinel, del, domainPtr->currentEpoch() + 1000))
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V3-2] FAIL: sentinel enqueue failed\n");
        return false;
    }

    const auto pendingBefore = domainPtr->pendingRetireCount();
    const auto quarantineBefore = convo::EpochDomain::quarantineCount();
    const bool queueOwnedBefore = domainPtr->queueAvailable();

    // proof は producer join 未完了のため成立しない（bare engine: rebuildThreadStopped=false）
    const bool ran = ShutdownHoldTestAccess::runCheckedDrain (*engine);

    if (ran)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V3-3] FAIL: checked drain succeeded without a valid proof\n");
        ok = false;
    }
    if (deletes.load() != 0)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V3-4] FAIL: deleter ran on proof failure (deleter=%d)\n",
                     deletes.load());
        ok = false;
    }
    if (domainPtr->pendingRetireCount() != pendingBefore)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V3-5] FAIL: queue content changed (pending=%u before=%u)\n",
                     static_cast<unsigned>(domainPtr->pendingRetireCount()),
                     static_cast<unsigned>(pendingBefore));
        ok = false;
    }
    if (! domainPtr->queueAvailable() || ! queueOwnedBefore)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V3-6] FAIL: queue ownership was transferred\n");
        ok = false;
    }
    if (convo::EpochDomain::quarantineCount() != quarantineBefore)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V3-7] FAIL: queue was quarantined on proof failure\n");
        ok = false;
    }

    if (ok)
        std::printf("[DQ-V3] proof unavailable: PASS (checked drain stops before capability "
                    "creation, queue retained, deleter 0)\n");
    return ok;
}

//==============================================================================
// ★ WORK113 (2026-11-18 Owner 指示 / 検証単位 4 補強版): capability は拒否されず発行される。
//   D を容量 4096 まで、Q と E を各 512 まで埋め、最終 retire の 1 件だけを
//   D に入れられなくする（D 満杯）→ fallback で T が受領する。
//   受領は T の**累積 store 回数**で確認する（epoch-safe な entry は T が即時破棄するため、
//   resident の増減に依存しない）。
//   並せて、drain が実行されるときに走る deleter（D の各 entry）と、
//   走ってはいけない deleter（Q / E の entry）を回数で区別する。
//==============================================================================
bool checkCapabilityIssuedWithFullFallback()
{
    bool ok = true;

    static std::atomic<int> dDeletes { 0 };
    static std::atomic<int> qDeletes { 0 };
    static std::atomic<int> eDeletes { 0 };
    dDeletes.store (0);
    qDeletes.store (0);
    eDeletes.store (0);

    auto dNoop = [](void*) noexcept { dDeletes.fetch_add (1, std::memory_order_relaxed); };
    auto qNoop = [](void*) noexcept { qDeletes.fetch_add (1, std::memory_order_relaxed); };
    auto eNoop = [](void*) noexcept { eDeletes.fetch_add (1, std::memory_order_relaxed); };

    // ★ fixture 寿命（Owner 指摘 2026-11-18）: sentinel の storage を engine より先に宣言する。
    //   ローカル変数は逆順で破棄されるため、この順序なら ~AudioEngine() が Q / E を処理する
    //   時点で sentinel はまだ生存している（deleter へ渡るポインタが有効である）。
    //   1) D / Q / E を容量まで埋める（D を満杯にして最終 retire の移送を失敗させる）
    constexpr int kDQueueCapacity = 4096;
    constexpr int kQCapacity = 512;
    constexpr int kECapacity = 512;
    std::vector<int> dSentinels (kDQueueCapacity);
    std::vector<int> qSentinels (kQCapacity);
    std::vector<int> eSentinels (kECapacity);

    auto engine = std::make_unique<AudioEngine>();
    auto* routerPtr = ShutdownHoldTestAccess::retireRouter (*engine);
    auto* domainPtr = ShutdownHoldTestAccess::epochDomainPtr (*engine);
    if (routerPtr == nullptr || domainPtr == nullptr)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V4-1] FAIL: engine substrate is null\n");
        return false;
    }

    int filledD = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < kDQueueCapacity; ++i)
    {
        if (! domainPtr->enqueueRetire (&dSentinels[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)], dNoop,
                                        domainPtr->currentEpoch() + 100000))
            break;
        ++filledD;
    }
    int filledQ = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < kQCapacity; ++i)
    {
        if (! routerPtr->quarantineRetire (&qSentinels[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)], qNoop,
                                           routerPtr->currentEpoch(),
                                           DeletionEntryType::Generic, "dq-v4-fill-q", 0, 0))
            break;
        ++filledQ;
    }
    int filledE = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < kECapacity; ++i)
    {
        if (! routerPtr->emergencyQuarantine (&eSentinels[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)], eNoop,
                                              routerPtr->currentEpoch(),
                                              DeletionEntryType::Generic, "dq-v4-fill-e", 0, 0))
            break;
        ++filledE;
    }

    const std::size_t qResident =
        routerPtr->quarantineResidentCount() - routerPtr->emergencyQuarantineResidentCount();
    const std::size_t eResident = routerPtr->emergencyQuarantineResidentCount();
    const std::uint64_t tStoreBefore = routerPtr->terminalStoreCount();
    const std::size_t tResidentBefore = routerPtr->terminalReclaimResidentCount();
    const auto quarantineBefore = convo::EpochDomain::quarantineCount();

    // 2) 生産と同じ順序で terminal shutdown の前提を作る（fence → gate close + epochAtFence）
    const bool publishersIdle = ShutdownHoldTestAccess::prepareTerminalShutdownForDrain (*engine);

    // 3) 最終 retire の対象を 1 件だけ用意する
    auto* snapshot = convo::SnapshotFactory::create (convo::SnapshotParams{});
    if (snapshot == nullptr)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V4-2] FAIL: snapshot creation failed\n");
        return false;
    }
    ShutdownHoldTestAccess::installSnapshot (*engine, snapshot);

    // 4) 生産の checked drain（proof → capability → take → drain）
    const bool ran = ShutdownHoldTestAccess::runCheckedDrain (*engine);
    const auto counts = ShutdownHoldTestAccess::finalizeCounts (*engine);
    const std::uint64_t tStoreAfter = routerPtr->terminalStoreCount();
    const std::size_t tResidentAfter = routerPtr->terminalReclaimResidentCount();
    // ★ Q / E の resident は checked drain の前後で不変であること（entry が別の場所へ
    //   移されていないこと）を直接 assert するため、drain 直後の値を取る。
    const std::size_t qResidentAfter =
        routerPtr->quarantineResidentCount() - routerPtr->emergencyQuarantineResidentCount();
    const std::size_t eResidentAfter = routerPtr->emergencyQuarantineResidentCount();
    const auto pendingAfter = domainPtr->pendingRetireCount();
    const auto quarantineAfter = convo::EpochDomain::quarantineCount();
    const auto remainingAfter = domainPtr->drainRemainingAfter();

    // 引き取り後の queue は enqueue できない（takeForShutdown 済みの観測）
    static int probeSentinel = 0;
    const bool queueUsableAfter =
        domainPtr->enqueueRetire (&probeSentinel, dNoop, domainPtr->currentEpoch() + 100000);

    // 前提の実測（満杯到達と gate 停止）
    if (filledD != kDQueueCapacity)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V4-3] FAIL: D did not reach capacity (filled=%d capacity=%d)\n",
                     filledD, kDQueueCapacity);
        ok = false;
    }
    if (filledQ != kQCapacity || qResident != kQCapacity)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V4-4] FAIL: Q did not reach capacity (filled=%d resident=%zu)\n",
                     filledQ, qResident);
        ok = false;
    }
    if (filledE != kECapacity || eResident != kECapacity)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V4-5] FAIL: E did not reach capacity (filled=%d resident=%zu)\n",
                     filledE, eResident);
        ok = false;
    }
    if (! publishersIdle)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V4-6] FAIL: publish gate did not go idle (epochAtFence unsettled)\n");
        ok = false;
    }

    // 1. checked drain が完了した（capability は発行された）
    if (! ran)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V4-7] FAIL: checked drain did not complete (capability refused)\n");
        ok = false;
    }
    if (remainingAfter != 0)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V4-8] FAIL: drain left entries behind (remaining=%llu)\n",
                     static_cast<unsigned long long>(remainingAfter));
        ok = false;
    }
    if (pendingAfter != 0 || queueUsableAfter)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V4-9] FAIL: queue ownership was not taken (pending=%u usable=%d)\n",
                     static_cast<unsigned>(pendingAfter), queueUsableAfter ? 1 : 0);
        ok = false;
    }
    if (quarantineAfter != quarantineBefore)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V4-10] FAIL: queue was quarantined (count=%llu -> %llu)\n",
                     static_cast<unsigned long long>(quarantineBefore),
                     static_cast<unsigned long long>(quarantineAfter));
        ok = false;
    }

    // 4. T が受領した（累積 store 回数で +1）
    if (tStoreAfter != tStoreBefore + 1)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr,
                     "[DQ-V4-11] FAIL: terminal store count did not increase by exactly 1 "
                     "(%llu -> %llu)\n",
                     static_cast<unsigned long long>(tStoreBefore),
                     static_cast<unsigned long long>(tStoreAfter));
        ok = false;
    }
    // 4b. Q / E の resident は drain 前後で不変（entry は移動も解放もされていない）
    if (qResidentAfter != kQCapacity)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr,
                     "[DQ-V4-17] FAIL: Q resident changed across the drain (%zu -> %zu)\n",
                     qResident, qResidentAfter);
        ok = false;
    }
    if (eResidentAfter != kECapacity)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr,
                     "[DQ-V4-18] FAIL: E resident changed across the drain (%zu -> %zu)\n",
                     eResident, eResidentAfter);
        ok = false;
    }

    // 5. requests == denqueues + fallbackTransfers（D 満杯で denqueue 失敗、fallback 成立）
    const auto transfers = counts.denqueues + counts.fallbackTransfers;
    if (counts.calls != 1 || counts.requests != 1)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V4-12] FAIL: finalize counts invalid (calls=%llu requests=%llu)\n",
                     static_cast<unsigned long long>(counts.calls),
                     static_cast<unsigned long long>(counts.requests));
        ok = false;
    }
    if (counts.denqueues != 0 || counts.fallbackTransfers != 1)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V4-13] FAIL: D was not full (denq=%llu fallback=%llu)\n",
                     static_cast<unsigned long long>(counts.denqueues),
                     static_cast<unsigned long long>(counts.fallbackTransfers));
        ok = false;
    }
    if (counts.requests != transfers)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr,
                     "[DQ-V4-14] FAIL: requests != denqueues + fallbackTransfers "
                     "(requests=%llu transfers=%llu)\n",
                     static_cast<unsigned long long>(counts.requests),
                     static_cast<unsigned long long>(transfers));
        ok = false;
    }

    // 6. deleter の区別: D は drain が実行し、Q / E は実行されない
    if (dDeletes.load() != filledD)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V4-15] FAIL: D deleter count %d != filled %d\n",
                     dDeletes.load(), filledD);
        ok = false;
    }
    if (qDeletes.load() != 0 || eDeletes.load() != 0)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-V4-16] FAIL: Q/E deleter ran unexpectedly (q=%d e=%d)\n",
                     qDeletes.load(), eDeletes.load());
        ok = false;
    }

    if (ok)
        std::printf("[DQ-V4] capability issued: PASS (D=%d/Q=%d/E=%d full, checked drain completed, "
                    "requests=%llu == denqueues+fallback, T store +1 (%zu -> %zu resident), "
                    "Q/E resident unchanged (%d/%d), D deleters=%d, Q/E deleters=0)\n",
                    filledD, filledQ, filledE,
                    static_cast<unsigned long long>(counts.requests),
                    tResidentBefore, tResidentAfter,
                    static_cast<int>(qResidentAfter), static_cast<int>(eResidentAfter),
                    dDeletes.load());
    return ok;
}

//==============================================================================
// ★ WORK113 (2026-11-19 Owner 指示): reader exit の途中で shutdown が quiescence を
//   判定できるかを、決定的な seam で観測する。[DQ-W1]
//   EpochDomain::exitReader() は slot.depth を 0 にした後も slot の診断・epoch・
//   quarantineFlags にアクセスする。その間に ~AudioEngine が静止判定を
//   行うと、activeReaderCount()==0 と isInside()==false になり得る。
//   ここでは engine を破棄せず、静止判定の入力が揃うことだけを確認する（UAF を避ける）。
//==============================================================================
bool checkReaderExitQuiescenceWindow()
{
    bool ok = true;

    struct Seam
    {
        std::atomic<bool> fired { false };      // 1 回だけ止めるためのフラグ
        std::atomic<bool> reached { false };
        std::atomic<bool> release { false };
        std::thread::id expectedTid {};         // 止める対象（worker）のスレッド
        std::atomic<bool> armed { false };      // worker が exit する直前に立てる
    };

    static Seam seam;
    seam.fired.store (false);
    seam.reached.store (false);
    seam.release.store (false);
    seam.armed.store (false);
    seam.expectedTid = std::thread::id();

    auto seamFn = [] (void* ctx) noexcept
    {
        // ★ 1 回だけ止める（~AudioEngine や他の reader の exit は止めない）。
        //   seam 自体はここで解除しない。解除と競合すると、旧関数ポインタと
        //   nullptr の ctx の組で呼ばれる経路ができる。解除は join 後に行う。
        auto* s = static_cast<Seam*> (ctx);
        if (s == nullptr)
            return;
        // ★ この seam は worker の exit だけを止める。engine が保有する他の reader の exit を
        //   止めると、観測する窓が別の reader のものになり判定がぶれる。
        if (! s->armed.load (std::memory_order_acquire)
            || std::this_thread::get_id() != s->expectedTid)
            return;
        bool expected = false;
        if (! s->fired.compare_exchange_strong (expected, true))
            return;
        s->reached.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
        while (! s->release.load (std::memory_order_acquire))
            std::this_thread::yield();
    };

    auto engine = std::make_unique<AudioEngine>();
    auto* domainPtr = ShutdownHoldTestAccess::epochDomainPtr (*engine);
    auto* routerPtr = ShutdownHoldTestAccess::retireRouter (*engine);
    if (domainPtr == nullptr || routerPtr == nullptr)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W1-1] FAIL: engine substrate is null\n");
        return false;
    }

    convo::EpochDomain::setReaderExitSeam (seamFn, &seam);

    std::atomic<convo::RCUReader*> readerPtr { nullptr };
    std::atomic<bool> entered { false };
    // ★ enter() が戻って失敗したときだけ立つ。
    //   enter 実行中（activity が先に非 0 になる）とは区別する。
    std::atomic<bool> entryFailed { false };
    std::atomic<bool> exitDone { false };

    std::thread worker ([&]
    {
        convo::RCUReader reader (*domainPtr);
        readerPtr.store (&reader, std::memory_order_release);
        const bool ok = reader.enter();
        entered.store (ok, std::memory_order_release);
        // ★ enter に失敗した場合は exit を呼ばない（depth は既に 0に戻っている）。
        //   失敗は enter が戻ってからだけ公開する（待ち側が実行中と誤判しない）。
        if (! ok)
        {
            entryFailed.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
            return;
        }
        // ★ seam を armed にしてから exit する。これで worker の exit だけが止まる。
        while (! seam.armed.load (std::memory_order_acquire))
            std::this_thread::yield();
        readerPtr.store (nullptr, std::memory_order_release);   // 以降は isInside だけを読む
        reader.exit();
        exitDone.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
    });

    // seam をこの worker の exit に限定する。
    seam.expectedTid = worker.get_id();
    seam.armed.store (true, std::memory_order_release);

    // ★ seam 到達を 1 つの期限で待つ。
    //   activity は enter 実行中にも非 0 になるため、打ち切り条件には使わない。
    //   打ち切りは「enter が戻って失敗したとき（entryFailed）だけ。
    const auto seamDeadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::milliseconds (2000);
    while (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < seamDeadline
           && ! seam.reached.load (std::memory_order_acquire)
           && ! entryFailed.load (std::memory_order_acquire))
        std::this_thread::sleep_for (std::chrono::microseconds (100));

    const bool reached = seam.reached.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (! reached)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W1-2] FAIL: read exit seam was not reached\n");
        ok = false;
    }

    // ここが実測する窓。
    // 修正後は activeReaderCount() が exit 処理中を含むため、
    // depth は 0 でも活動数は 1 以上になる（これが修正の要点）。
    const std::uint32_t depthReaders = domainPtr->activeDepthReaderCount();
    const std::uint32_t activity = routerPtr->activeReaderCount();
    const std::uint32_t exiting = activity > depthReaders ? activity - depthReaders : 0u;
    const std::uint32_t admissionsActive = domainPtr->readerAdmissionsActive();
    const std::uint32_t admissionPending = domainPtr->admissionPendingSlots();
    const bool exitFinished = exitDone.load (std::memory_order_acquire);

    if (exitFinished)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W1-3] FAIL: exit finished before the seam (window lost)\n");
        ok = false;
    }
    if (depthReaders != 0)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W1-4] FAIL: depth readers=%u inside the window\n",
                     static_cast<unsigned> (depthReaders));
        ok = false;
    }
    if (exiting < 1)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W1-5] FAIL: exit-in-progress not counted (activity=%u depth=%u)\n",
                     static_cast<unsigned> (activity), static_cast<unsigned> (depthReaders));
        ok = false;
    }
    if (admissionsActive != 0 || admissionPending != 0)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W1-6] FAIL: admission not idle (active=%u pending=%u)\n",
                     static_cast<unsigned> (admissionsActive),
                     static_cast<unsigned> (admissionPending));
        ok = false;
    }

    // Q4（proof の入力）が false になること。
    if (ShutdownHoldTestAccess::readerActivityZero (*engine))
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W1-7] FAIL: Q4 (activeReadersZero) is true inside the window\n");
        ok = false;
    }

    // proof → capability → checked drain の前提を整える。準備自体の成功を必須にする
    //   （publisher 停止のタイムアウトなど、reader 以外の理由で拒否される状態を除外する）。
    const bool prepared = ShutdownHoldTestAccess::prepareTerminalShutdownForDrain (*engine);
    if (! prepared)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W1-8] FAIL: terminal shutdown preparation failed\n");
        ok = false;
    }
    else if (ShutdownHoldTestAccess::readerActivityZero (*engine))
    {
        // ★ 準備後（registration 閉鎖 + reader fence 済み）でも、seam 保持中は Q4 が false で
        //   あること。ここを見ないと「fence までは false だが、fence 後は exit 活動を
        //   無視する」退行を見逃す。
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W1-8b] FAIL: Q4 is true after preparation while the seam is held\n");
        ok = false;
    }
    if (ShutdownHoldTestAccess::runCheckedDrain (*engine))
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W1-9] FAIL: checked drain completed inside the window\n");
        ok = false;
    }

    // seam を放して exit を完了させる（engine は破棄しない）
    seam.release.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
    worker.join();
    convo::EpochDomain::setReaderExitSeam (nullptr, nullptr);

    if (! entered.load (std::memory_order_acquire))
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W1-11] FAIL: reader.enter() failed\n");
        ok = false;
    }
    if (! exitDone.load (std::memory_order_acquire))
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W1-12] FAIL: exit did not complete after the seam\n");
        ok = false;
    }
    // exit 完了後（admission も idle）は Q4 が true に戻ること。
    if (! ShutdownHoldTestAccess::readerActivityZero (*engine))
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W1-12b] FAIL: Q4 is still false after the exit completed "
                             "(activity=%u pendingSlots=%u admissions=%u)\n",
                     static_cast<unsigned> (routerPtr->activeReaderCount()),
                     static_cast<unsigned> (domainPtr->admissionPendingSlots()),
                     static_cast<unsigned> (domainPtr->readerAdmissionsActive()));
        ok = false;
    }

    // 同じ fixture で checked drain が完了すること。これで、上の拒否の理由が
    // 「exit 中の活動数」だけだったことを切り分けられる。
    if (! ShutdownHoldTestAccess::runCheckedDrain (*engine))
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W1-13] FAIL: checked drain did not complete after the exit\n");
        ok = false;
    }

    if (routerPtr->activeReaderCount() != 0)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W1-14] FAIL: activity not released after exit (%u)\n",
                     static_cast<unsigned> (routerPtr->activeReaderCount()));
        ok = false;
    }

    if (ok)
        std::printf ("[DQ-W1] exit window: PASS (depth=%u activity=%u exiting=%u; "
                     "Q4 false, checked drain refused inside the window and completed after the exit)\n",
                     static_cast<unsigned> (depthReaders),
                     static_cast<unsigned> (activity),
                     static_cast<unsigned> (exiting));
    return ok;
}

//==============================================================================
// ★ WORK113 R1 (2026-11-19 Owner 承認): 破壊的プローブ。
//   reader が exit の途中で止まっている間に ~AudioEngine を実行する。
//   修正前は静止判定が成立して基盤を破棄し、再開した exitReader が解放済み slot に
//   書き込む（ASan で UAF）。修正後は基盤がプロセス寿命へ移され、exit は正常完了する。
//==============================================================================
bool checkReaderExitShutdownRace()
{
    bool ok = true;

    struct Seam
    {
        std::atomic<bool> fired { false };      // 1 回だけ止めるためのフラグ
        std::atomic<bool> reached { false };
        std::atomic<bool> release { false };
        std::thread::id expectedTid {};         // 止める対象（worker）のスレッド
        std::atomic<bool> armed { false };      // worker が exit する直前に立てる
    };

    static Seam seam;
    seam.fired.store (false);
    seam.reached.store (false);
    seam.release.store (false);
    seam.armed.store (false);
    seam.expectedTid = std::thread::id();

    auto seamFn = [] (void* ctx) noexcept
    {
        // ★ 1 回だけ止める（~AudioEngine や他の reader の exit は止めない）。
        //   seam 自体はここで解除しない。解除と競合すると、旧関数ポインタと
        //   nullptr の ctx の組で呼ばれる経路ができる。解除は join 後に行う。
        auto* s = static_cast<Seam*> (ctx);
        if (s == nullptr)
            return;
        // ★ この seam は worker の exit だけを止める。engine が保有する他の reader の exit を
        //   止めると、観測する窓が別の reader のものになり判定がぶれる。
        if (! s->armed.load (std::memory_order_acquire)
            || std::this_thread::get_id() != s->expectedTid)
            return;
        bool expected = false;
        if (! s->fired.compare_exchange_strong (expected, true))
            return;
        s->reached.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
        while (! s->release.load (std::memory_order_acquire))
            std::this_thread::yield();
    };

    const int abandonedBefore = ShutdownHoldTestAccess::abandonedReaderSubstrates();
    const int overflowsBefore = ShutdownHoldTestAccess::abandonedSubstrateOverflows();
    // ★ 診断索引が満杯して overflow 側で保持されると、保持されたものを特定できない。
    //   そこでこの engine の router に破棄フラグを登録し、overflow 側でも
    //   同じ router が生存したままであることを固定する（他のインスタンスの
    //   破棄では立たない）。
    std::atomic<bool> routerDestroyed { false };
    // ★ overflow 側では記録が残らないため、domain の存甘も独立して確認する。
    //   router だけを見ると、router を保持して domain だけを破棄する退行を見逃す。
    std::atomic<bool> domainDestroyed { false };
    const int instancesBefore = ShutdownHoldTestAccess::engineInstanceCount();

    auto engine = std::make_unique<AudioEngine>();
    // ★ タイムアウトはバウンド付きで長めに取る。50 ms だと、待機中に
    //   スレッドが 50 ms 以上デスケジュールされただけで idle の待機がタイムアウトし、
    //   保持の理由が exit であることを誤判する。graceful drain の遅延は短いままにする。
    ShutdownHoldTestAccess::setShutdownWaitTimeout (*engine, 500);
    auto* domainPtr = ShutdownHoldTestAccess::epochDomainPtr (*engine);
    auto* routerPtr = ShutdownHoldTestAccess::retireRouter (*engine);
    if (domainPtr == nullptr || routerPtr == nullptr)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W3-1] FAIL: engine substrate is null\n");
        return false;
    }
    convo::isr::ISRRetireRouter::armDestructionProbeForTest (routerPtr, &routerDestroyed);
    convo::EpochDomain::armDestructionProbeForTest (domainPtr, &domainDestroyed);

    // ★ 早期リターンを含む全経路で解除する。フラグはこの関数のローカルなので、
    //   戻った後に別の router が同じアドレスで破棄されても書かれないようにする。
    struct DestructionProbeGuard
    {
        ~DestructionProbeGuard()
        {
            convo::isr::ISRRetireRouter::armDestructionProbeForTest (nullptr, nullptr);
            convo::EpochDomain::armDestructionProbeForTest (nullptr, nullptr);
        }
    };
    const DestructionProbeGuard destructionProbeGuard;

    convo::EpochDomain::setReaderExitSeam (seamFn, &seam);

    std::atomic<bool> entered { false };
    // ★ enter() が戻って失敗したときだけ立つ（実行中とは区別する）。
    std::atomic<bool> entryFailed { false };
    std::atomic<bool> exitDone { false };

    // ★ engine が使う provider（ISRRetireRouter）で reader を作る。EpochDomain を直接使うと、
    //   domain は存命しても router が破棔される場合を検出できない。
    auto& workerProvider = ShutdownHoldTestAccess::readerProvider (*engine);

    std::thread worker ([&]
    {
        convo::RCUReader reader (workerProvider);
        const bool ok = reader.enter();
        entered.store (ok, std::memory_order_release);
        // ★ enter に失敗した場合は exit を呼ばない（depth は既に 0に戻っている）。
        //   失敗は enter が戻ってからだけ公開する（待ち側が実行中と誤判しない）。
        if (! ok)
        {
            entryFailed.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
            return;
        }
        // ★ seam を armed にしてから exit する。これで worker の exit だけが止まる。
        while (! seam.armed.load (std::memory_order_acquire))
            std::this_thread::yield();
        reader.exit();
        exitDone.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
    });

    // seam をこの worker の exit に限定する。
    seam.expectedTid = worker.get_id();
    seam.armed.store (true, std::memory_order_release);

    // ★ seam 到達を 1 つの期限で待つ。打ち切りは enter 失敗のみ。
    const auto seamDeadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::milliseconds (2000);
    while (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < seamDeadline
           && ! seam.reached.load (std::memory_order_acquire)
           && ! entryFailed.load (std::memory_order_acquire))
        std::this_thread::sleep_for (std::chrono::microseconds (100));

    if (! seam.reached.load (std::memory_order_acquire))
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W3-2] FAIL: exit seam was not reached\n");
        seam.release.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
        worker.join();
        convo::EpochDomain::setReaderExitSeam (nullptr, nullptr);
        return false;
    }

    // ★ 保持の理由が「exit 実行中の reader」だけに絞られることを確かめるため、
    //   publisher の idle 待ちタイムアウトと admission の状態を前後で比べる。
    //   どちらかが原因でも基盤は保持されるため、これを見ないと
    //   別の理由で PASS し得る。
    // ★ reset 後は domain が破棄されている可能性があるため、タイムアウトは
    //   プロセス定数で前後を比べる。
    const int publishIdleFailuresBefore = AudioEngine::shutdownPublisherIdleFailuresForTest();
    // ★ admission の待ちは、期限切れなら idle でも false になる。タイムアウトで保持された
    //   場合は、exit 実行中の reader が理由ではないため、この計数を前後で比べる。
    const int admissionIdleFailuresBefore = AudioEngine::shutdownReaderAdmissionIdleFailuresForTest();
    const std::uint32_t admissionsBeforeDestroy = domainPtr->readerAdmissionsActive();
    const std::uint32_t pendingSlotsBeforeDestroy = domainPtr->admissionPendingSlots();

    // ★ 破壊前の状態を固定する。depth 0 かつ活動数 > 0（exit 実行中）でなければ、
    //   DQ-W3 は「exit 実行中の破棄」を検証していない（既存の active-reader hold 経路を
    //   通るだけになる）。状態が違う場合は破棄せずに片付ける。
    {
        const std::uint32_t depthBeforeDestroy = domainPtr->activeDepthReaderCount();
        const std::uint32_t activityBeforeDestroy = routerPtr->activeReaderCount();
        if (depthBeforeDestroy != 0 || activityBeforeDestroy == 0)
        {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W3-2b] FAIL: unexpected state before destruction "
                                 "(depth=%u activity=%u)\n",
                         static_cast<unsigned> (depthBeforeDestroy),
                         static_cast<unsigned> (activityBeforeDestroy));
            seam.release.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
            worker.join();
            convo::EpochDomain::setReaderExitSeam (nullptr, nullptr);
            return false;
        }
    }

    // ★ exit 停止中に強制解放しないことを固定する。future epoch の sentinel は
    //   通常の epoch 回収では対象外なので、deleter が 1 回でも走れば
    //   強制解放した証拠になる（保持のみなら 0 回）。
    g_exitWindowDrainDeletes.store (0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    // ★ deleter 0 回だけでは、queue を deleter なしで捨てた場合を見逃す。
    //   保持されたことを quarantine の増分でも確認する。
    const auto quarantineBefore = convo::EpochDomain::quarantineCount();
    const auto quarantinePendingBefore = convo::EpochDomain::quarantinePendingEntries();
    {
        static int exitWindowSentinel = 0;
        if (! domainPtr->enqueueRetire (&exitWindowSentinel, exitWindowDrainDeleter,
                                        domainPtr->currentEpoch() + 1000000ull))
        {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W3-3h] FAIL: future-epoch sentinel enqueue failed\n");
            ok = false;
        }
    }

    // ★ ここが破壊的な操作：exit 実行中に engine を破棄する。
    engine.reset();

    // ★ router が破棄されていないこと（overflow 側でも確認する）。
    //   件数の増分だけでは、保持されたのが domain だけで router が
    //   破棄された退行を見逃す。この計数は破棄後のオブジェクトを
    //   参照しないため、生存を判定できる。
    if (routerDestroyed.load (std::memory_order_acquire))
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W3-3f] FAIL: retire router was destroyed during teardown\n");
        ok = false;
    }
    if (domainDestroyed.load (std::memory_order_acquire))
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W3-3g] FAIL: epoch domain was destroyed during teardown\n");
        ok = false;
    }
    // ★ 停止中の exit に対して強制解放していないこと（future epoch は回収対象外）。
    if (g_exitWindowDrainDeletes.load (std::memory_order_relaxed) != 0)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W3-3i] FAIL: teardown force-reclaimed a future-epoch entry "
                             "(deletes=%d)\n",
                     g_exitWindowDrainDeletes.load (std::memory_order_relaxed));
        ok = false;
    }
    // ★ deleter を実行せずに queue を捨てた場合も検出する。
    //   保持なら quarantine に 1 件増え、処理待ちも増える。
    const auto quarantineAfter = convo::EpochDomain::quarantineCount();
    const auto quarantinePendingAfter = convo::EpochDomain::quarantinePendingEntries();
    if (quarantineAfter != quarantineBefore + 1)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W3-3j] FAIL: teardown did not quarantine the D sentinel "
                             "(count %llu -> %llu)\n",
                     static_cast<unsigned long long>(quarantineBefore),
                     static_cast<unsigned long long>(quarantineAfter));
        ok = false;
    }
    if (quarantinePendingAfter < quarantinePendingBefore + 1)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W3-3k] FAIL: quarantined entry is not pending "
                             "(pending %llu -> %llu)\n",
                     static_cast<unsigned long long>(quarantinePendingBefore),
                     static_cast<unsigned long long>(quarantinePendingAfter));
        ok = false;
    }

    // 基盤は保持され、プロセス寿命へ移される。
    // 診断索引は固定容量（8）のため、満杯時は保持の証拠を overflow 側で取る。
    const int abandonedAfter = ShutdownHoldTestAccess::abandonedReaderSubstrates();
    const int overflowsAfter = ShutdownHoldTestAccess::abandonedSubstrateOverflows();
    const bool retained = (abandonedAfter == abandonedBefore + 1)
                       || (overflowsAfter == overflowsBefore + 1);
    if (! retained)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W3-3] FAIL: substrate not retained "
                             "(abandoned %d -> %d, overflow %d -> %d)\n",
                     abandonedBefore, abandonedAfter, overflowsBefore, overflowsAfter);
        ok = false;
    }

    // ★ 保持されたのが「同じ router と domain の組」であること。件数だけでは、
    //   router を破棄して domain だけ残す退行を見逃す。
    //   診断索引が満杯して overflow 側で保持された場合は記録が無いため、
    //   記録が増えたときだけ同一性を要求する。
    const bool recordedInIndex = (abandonedAfter == abandonedBefore + 1);
    if (recordedInIndex && ! AudioEngine::abandonedSubstrateContainsForTest (routerPtr, domainPtr))
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W3-3e] FAIL: abandoned record does not hold the same router/domain\n");
        ok = false;
    }

    // ★ publisher の idle タイムアウトで保持されていないこと。
    if (AudioEngine::shutdownPublisherIdleFailuresForTest() != publishIdleFailuresBefore)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W3-3b] FAIL: publisher idle timed out during teardown "
                             "(failures %d -> %d)\n",
                     publishIdleFailuresBefore,
                     AudioEngine::shutdownPublisherIdleFailuresForTest());
        ok = false;
    }
    // ★ admission の idle 待ちがタイムアウトしていないこと（期限切れは idle でも false）。
    if (AudioEngine::shutdownReaderAdmissionIdleFailuresForTest() != admissionIdleFailuresBefore)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W3-3d] FAIL: admission idle wait timed out during teardown "
                             "(failures %d -> %d)\n",
                     admissionIdleFailuresBefore,
                     AudioEngine::shutdownReaderAdmissionIdleFailuresForTest());
        ok = false;
    }
    // ★ admission が残って保持されていないこと（残っていれば別の理由）。
    if (admissionsBeforeDestroy != 0u || pendingSlotsBeforeDestroy != 0u)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W3-3c] FAIL: admission was not idle before destruction "
                             "(active=%u pending=%u)\n",
                     static_cast<unsigned> (admissionsBeforeDestroy),
                     static_cast<unsigned> (pendingSlotsBeforeDestroy));
        ok = false;
    }

    // exit を再開させる（保持された基盤の上で完了すること）。
    seam.release.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
    worker.join();
    convo::EpochDomain::setReaderExitSeam (nullptr, nullptr);

    if (! entered.load (std::memory_order_acquire))
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W3-4] FAIL: reader.enter() failed\n");
        ok = false;
    }
    if (! exitDone.load (std::memory_order_acquire))
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W3-5] FAIL: exit did not complete after the engine was destroyed\n");
        ok = false;
    }
    if (ShutdownHoldTestAccess::engineInstanceCount() != instancesBefore)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[DQ-W3-6] FAIL: engine instance count not restored (%d -> %d)\n",
                     instancesBefore, ShutdownHoldTestAccess::engineInstanceCount());
        ok = false;
    }

    if (ok)
        std::printf ("[DQ-W3] exit vs shutdown: PASS (abandoned %d -> %d, overflow %d -> %d, "
                     "exit completed after destruction)\n",
                     abandonedBefore, abandonedAfter, overflowsBefore, overflowsAfter);
    return ok;
}

int runV11EngineRetireProtectionTests()
{
    // U3: V11 のアロケーション計測はこの実行の間だけ有効化する（既定 OFF）。
    g_v11eReclaimCalls = 0;
    g_v11eLastReclaimed = nullptr;

    if (!checkEngineLevelProtection())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkV11EngineRetireProtection\n");
        return 1;
    }
    if (!checkInCallbackRetireProtection())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkV11InCallbackRetireProtection\n");
        return 1;
    }
    // HD-1 and HD-3 are independent observations of the same defect class. Run both so one
    // failure does not hide the other's result; this is the C-1 evidence run.
    bool hdOk = true;
    if (!checkHandleLifetimeDestroyedActiveDoesNotResolve())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkHandleLifetimeDestroyedActiveDoesNotResolve (HD-1)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkHandleLifetimeNoDuplicateRegistration())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkHandleLifetimeNoDuplicateRegistration (HD-3)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkF1PinLifecycle())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkF1PinLifecycle (F1-1..F1-5, F1-7)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkF1PinAcrossRegistrationClose())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkF1PinAcrossRegistrationClose (F1-6)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkF1bDeferredDestroyRetainsOwnership())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkF1bDeferredDestroyRetainsOwnership (F1-b)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkF1bTerminalRetainsDeferred())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkF1bTerminalRetainsDeferred (F1-b)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkF1bRetirePathsKeepOwnership())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkF1bRetirePathsKeepOwnership (F1-b)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkF1bDrainAllDoesNotForceFree())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkF1bDrainAllDoesNotForceFree (F1-b)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkF1bProductionRetireUnderPin())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkF1bProductionRetireUnderPin (F1-b)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }

    if (!checkF1bRetireDeferOrderInvariance())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkF1bRetireDeferOrderInvariance (F1-b V3/V4)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    // R-51: 2 エンジン共存時も pin 契約が維持されること（恒久テスト）。
    if (!checkR51TwoEngineOwnerCollision())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkR51TwoEngineOwnerCollision (R-51)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkF2QuarantineDestroyHonoursPins())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkF2QuarantineDestroyHonoursPins (F2)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkGReclaimNormalUsesRetireEpoch())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkGReclaimNormalUsesRetireEpoch (G)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkF1bAuditNormalTickCollects())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkF1bAuditNormalTickCollects (audit A)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkF1bAuditSingleOwnership())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkF1bAuditSingleOwnership (audit B)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkT9DspDeleteCountObservable())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkT9DspDeleteCountObservable (T9)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkT10cProductionProviderPath())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkT10cProductionProviderPath (T10-c)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkA2ProbeMechanism())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkA2ProbeMechanism (A2 P1/P2/N1/N3)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkA2ProbeThreadIsolation())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkA2ProbeThreadIsolation (A2 N2)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkA2ProbeRetirePath())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkA2ProbeRetirePath (A2 T1)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkDSPHandleResolveStates())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkDSPHandleResolveStates (P2-1)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkDrainGateContract())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkDrainGateContract (DQ-G)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkReaderFenceContract())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkReaderFenceContract (DQ-F)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkQuarantineContract())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkQuarantineContract (DQ-Q)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkShutdownHoldContract())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkShutdownHoldContract (DQ-H)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkShutdownHoldReaderResume())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkShutdownHoldReaderResume (DQ-H2)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkShutdownHoldPublisherObserverRace())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkShutdownHoldPublisherObserverRace (DQ-H3)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkShutdownHoldPublisherTimeout())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkShutdownHoldPublisherTimeout (DQ-H4)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkShutdownHoldActiveReader())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkShutdownHoldActiveReader (DQ-H5)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkShutdownHoldEngineReader())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkShutdownHoldEngineReader (DQ-H6)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkRetainedStoresHoldOwnership())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkRetainedStoresHoldOwnership (DQ-V1)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkDeferredCoreNotRetried())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkDeferredCoreNotRetried (DQ-V2)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkProofUnavailableKeepsOwnership())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkProofUnavailableKeepsOwnership (DQ-V3)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkCapabilityIssuedWithFullFallback())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkCapabilityIssuedWithFullFallback (DQ-V4)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkReaderExitQuiescenceWindow())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkReaderExitQuiescenceWindow (DQ-W1)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!checkReaderExitShutdownRace())
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: checkReaderExitShutdownRace (DQ-W3)\n");
        hdOk = false;
    }
    if (!hdOk)
        return 1;
    return 0;
}

// ============================================================================
// B2 Stage 1 / T1 — 陽性対照（positive controls）  R-01 / 2026-10-28
//
// 仕様の正本: B2-T1-IMPLEMENTATION-SCOPE-V53-20261028.md (v5.3)
//
// 【目的（この範囲だけ）】
//   convo::aligned_malloc 系の確保が convo::diag::totalAllocBytes へ、
//   ::freeTracked の解放が convo::diag::totalFreedBytes へ、正しく計上されることを
//   陽性対照で確認する。
//
// 【目的でないもの（この出力から導いてはいけない）】
//   - B2 全体の採用判断（別承認）。`b2_adoption` は本系列限りの適格性のみを表す。
//   - src/ の製品コードの変更・検証。
//   - 「構造的に隔離されている」ことの証明。isolation_label は観測値であり、
//     observed_isolated は「観測された範囲で隔離条件を満たした」以上の意味を持たない。
//
// 【実行方法】
//   環境変数 B2_STAGE1_MEASURE=1 を設定すると、PublishPipelineIntegrationTests.cpp の
//   main() がエンジン生成・スレッド生成より前に本関数へ分岐する。
//
// 【出力】stdout に 1 行 1 レコード。判定は summary 行の
//   counter_result / isolation_label / overall_result / b2_adoption を機械的に読む。
// ============================================================================
#if CONVOPEQ_ENABLE_RUNTIME_DIAGNOSTICS

namespace {

/// P1-B の陽性対照用 POD。sizeof == 123 を期待値として固定する（計画 v5.3 の例と同一）。
struct B2ProbePOD
{
    unsigned char payload[123];
};

struct B2S1Counters
{
    std::uint64_t alloc = 0;
    std::uint64_t freed = 0;
};

B2S1Counters b2s1Counters() noexcept
{
    return B2S1Counters{ convo::diag::totalAllocBytes(), convo::diag::totalFreedBytes() };
}

/// アイドルゲートの待機時間（計画 v5.3 §2.4: 各ゲート 500 ms）。
void b2s1IdleWait() noexcept
{
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(500));
}

/// 自プロセスのスレッド数。Toolhelp のスナップショットに含まれる自 PID のスレッドを数える。
/// 取得失敗時は 0 を返す（0 は「不明」であり、比較には使わない）。
unsigned b2s1ThreadCount() noexcept
{
    const DWORD pid = ::GetCurrentProcessId();
    const HANDLE snap = ::CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPTHREAD, 0);
    if (snap == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE)
        return 0;

    unsigned count = 0;
    THREADENTRY32 entry{};
    entry.dwSize = sizeof(entry);
    if (::Thread32First(snap, &entry) != FALSE)
    {
        do
        {
            if (entry.th32OwnerProcessID == pid)
                ++count;
        } while (::Thread32Next(snap, &entry) != FALSE);
    }
    ::CloseHandle(snap);
    return count;
}

} // namespace

/// 戻り値 = 停止条件番号（0 = 全ゲート通過）。値は計画 v5.3 §4 の表に一致させる。
int runB2Stage1PositiveControls()
{
    std::setvbuf(stdout, nullptr, _IONBF, 0);

    // 観測された隔離性（counter_result とは独立。§3.3）。
    bool degraded = false;
    char degradedAt[16] = {};

    // G9 失敗時は系列全体が無効（§8.2 規則 1）。
    bool g9Failed = false;

    auto finish = [&](int exitCode, const char* counterResult, const char* overallResult,
                      bool overallValid) -> int
    {
        char label[48] = {};
        if (degraded)
            std::snprintf(label, sizeof(label), "degraded:I2@%s", degradedAt);
        else
            std::snprintf(label, sizeof(label), "observed_isolated");

        // 採用適格性は mechanical に決まる（§10.2）: VALID かつ observed_isolated のときだけ eligible。
        const bool eligible = overallValid && !degraded;

        std::printf("[B2S1] summary counter_result=%s isolation_label=%s overall_result=%s"
                    " b2_adoption=%s exit=%d",
                    counterResult, label, overallResult, eligible ? "eligible" : "ineligible", exitCode);
        if (g9Failed)
            std::printf(" note=local_stage_results_are_reference_only");
        std::printf("\n");
        std::fflush(stdout);
        return exitCode;
    };

    std::printf("[B2S1] adoption_criteria_version=v5.3\n");
    std::fflush(stdout);

    try
    {
        // ====================================================================
        // G0 — アイドルゲート（基準取得 + I2 の初期確認。§1 の「I2 は G0 のみ確認」）
        // ====================================================================
        {
            const B2S1Counters base = b2s1Counters();
            const unsigned threadsBefore = b2s1ThreadCount();
            b2s1IdleWait();
            const B2S1Counters after = b2s1Counters();
            const unsigned threadsAfter = b2s1ThreadCount();

            const std::uint64_t idleAlloc = after.alloc - base.alloc;
            const std::uint64_t idleFreed = after.freed - base.freed;
            const bool counterOk = (idleAlloc == 0 && idleFreed == 0);
            const bool threadsOk = (threadsBefore == threadsAfter);

            std::printf("[B2S1] stage=G0 stage_result=%s idle_alloc_delta=%llu idle_freed_delta=%llu"
                        " threads=%u baseline_alloc=%llu baseline_freed=%llu\n",
                        (counterOk && threadsOk) ? "PASS" : "FAIL",
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(idleAlloc),
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(idleFreed),
                        threadsAfter,
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(base.alloc),
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(base.freed));
            std::fflush(stdout);

            if (!counterOk)
                return finish(1, "FAIL", "INVALID:STOP@1", false);
            if (!threadsOk)
                return finish(8, "PASS", "INVALID:STOP@8", false);
        }

        // ====================================================================
        // P1-A — makeAlignedArray<double>(1024) → aligned_free（強ゲート: 8192 B）
        //   規約 L1..L4（§9.2）: 保有者から release() で切り離してから解放する。
        // ====================================================================
        {
            const unsigned threadsBefore = b2s1ThreadCount();
            const B2S1Counters before = b2s1Counters();

            bool releasedPreNonnull = false;
            bool releaseInvoked = false;
            bool pointerInvalidated = false;
            {
                auto holder = convo::makeAlignedArray<double>(1024);      // 1024 * 8 = 8192 B
                releasedPreNonnull = (holder.get() != nullptr);
                double* raw = holder.release();                           // L1: 保有者から切り離す
                pointerInvalidated = (holder.get() == nullptr);            // L2: 保有者の無効化を確認
                convo::aligned_free(raw);                                  // L1: 実際の解放
                releaseInvoked = true;
                raw = nullptr;                                             // L3: 以後 raw を参照しない
            }

            const B2S1Counters after = b2s1Counters();
            const unsigned threadsAfter = b2s1ThreadCount();

            const std::uint64_t allocDelta = after.alloc - before.alloc;
            const std::uint64_t freedDelta = after.freed - before.freed;
            const int released = (releasedPreNonnull && releaseInvoked && pointerInvalidated) ? 1 : 0;

            // 停止条件 9: 作成中にスレッドが増減した場合は「隔離性の劣化」であって
            // カウンタの合否ではない（§3.3）。段階名を添えて記録する。
            if (threadsBefore != threadsAfter && !degraded)
            {
                degraded = true;
                std::snprintf(degradedAt, sizeof(degradedAt), "P1-A");
            }

            const bool counterOk = (allocDelta == 8192u && freedDelta == 0 && released == 1);

            std::printf("[B2S1] stage=P1-A stage_result=%s alloc_delta=%llu freed_delta=%llu"
                        " released_pre_nonnull=%d release_invoked=%d pointer_invalidated=%d"
                        " released=%d route=aligned_free threads_before=%u threads_after=%u\n",
                        counterOk ? "PASS" : "FAIL",
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(allocDelta),
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(freedDelta),
                        releasedPreNonnull ? 1 : 0, releaseInvoked ? 1 : 0,
                        pointerInvalidated ? 1 : 0, released,
                        threadsBefore, threadsAfter);
            std::fflush(stdout);

            if (released != 1)
                return finish(11, "FAIL", "INVALID:SETUP", false);   // §9.1 規則 4 / 停止条件 11
            if (!counterOk)
                return finish(2, "FAIL", "INVALID:STOP@2", false);    // 期待値は緩めない
        }

        // ====================================================================
        // P1-B — aligned_make_unique<B2ProbePOD>() → reset()（強ゲート: sizeof(POD)）
        //   aligned_free 系は DIAG を経由しないため freed_delta == 0 が期待値。
        // ====================================================================
        {
            const unsigned threadsBefore = b2s1ThreadCount();
            const B2S1Counters before = b2s1Counters();

            bool releasedPreNonnull = false;
            bool pointerInvalidated = false;

                auto probe = convo::aligned_make_unique<B2ProbePOD>();
                releasedPreNonnull = (probe.get() != nullptr);
                probe.reset();
                pointerInvalidated = (probe.get() == nullptr);

            const B2S1Counters after = b2s1Counters();
            const unsigned threadsAfter = b2s1ThreadCount();

            const std::uint64_t allocDelta = after.alloc - before.alloc;
            const std::uint64_t freedDelta = after.freed - before.freed;
            const bool releaseInvoked = true;
            const int released = (releasedPreNonnull && releaseInvoked && pointerInvalidated) ? 1 : 0;
            const std::uint64_t expected = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(sizeof(B2ProbePOD));

            if (threadsBefore != threadsAfter && !degraded)
            {
                degraded = true;
                std::snprintf(degradedAt, sizeof(degradedAt), "P1-B");
            }

            const bool counterOk = (allocDelta == expected && freedDelta == 0 && released == 1);

            std::printf("[B2S1] stage=P1-B stage_result=%s alloc_delta=%llu freed_delta=%llu"
                        " released_pre_nonnull=%d release_invoked=%d pointer_invalidated=%d"
                        " released=%d route=AlignedObjectDeleter"
                        " expected=%llu threads_before=%u threads_after=%u\n",
                        counterOk ? "PASS" : "FAIL",
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(allocDelta),
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(freedDelta),
                        releasedPreNonnull ? 1 : 0, releaseInvoked ? 1 : 0,
                        pointerInvalidated ? 1 : 0, released,
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(expected),
                        threadsBefore, threadsAfter);
            std::fflush(stdout);

            if (released != 1)
                return finish(11, "FAIL", "INVALID:SETUP", false);
            if (!counterOk)
                return finish(3, "FAIL", "INVALID:STOP@3", false);
        }

        // ====================================================================
        // P2' — aligned_malloc(N,64) → ::freeTracked(p, N)（強ゲート: N / N）
        //   freeTracked は DIAG 経由なので freed_delta に N が乗る。
        // ====================================================================
        {
            const std::size_t kN = 4096;
            const unsigned threadsBefore = b2s1ThreadCount();
            const B2S1Counters before = b2s1Counters();

            bool releasedPreNonnull = false;
            bool pointerInvalidated = false;
            {
                void* p = convo::aligned_malloc(kN, 64);
                releasedPreNonnull = (p != nullptr);
                ::freeTracked(p, kN);                 // 解放 + nullptr 代入（DiagnosticsConfig.h）
                pointerInvalidated = (p == nullptr);
            }

            const B2S1Counters after = b2s1Counters();
            const unsigned threadsAfter = b2s1ThreadCount();

            const std::uint64_t allocDelta = after.alloc - before.alloc;
            const std::uint64_t freedDelta = after.freed - before.freed;
            const bool releaseInvoked = true;
            const int released = (releasedPreNonnull && releaseInvoked && pointerInvalidated) ? 1 : 0;

            if (threadsBefore != threadsAfter && !degraded)
            {
                degraded = true;
                std::snprintf(degradedAt, sizeof(degradedAt), "P2'");
            }

            const bool counterOk = (allocDelta == kN && freedDelta == kN && released == 1);

            std::printf("[B2S1] stage=P2' stage_result=%s N=%llu alloc_delta=%llu freed_delta=%llu"
                        " released_pre_nonnull=%d release_invoked=%d pointer_invalidated=%d"
                        " released=%d route=freeTracked threads_before=%u threads_after=%u\n",
                        counterOk ? "PASS" : "FAIL",
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(kN),
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(allocDelta),
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(freedDelta),
                        releasedPreNonnull ? 1 : 0, releaseInvoked ? 1 : 0,
                        pointerInvalidated ? 1 : 0, released,
                        threadsBefore, threadsAfter);
            std::fflush(stdout);

            if (released != 1)
                return finish(11, "FAIL", "INVALID:SETUP", false);
            if (!counterOk)
                return finish(4, "FAIL", "INVALID:STOP@4", false);
        }

        // ====================================================================
        // P1-C — aligned_make_unique<AudioEngine::DSPCore>()（記録のみ・評価しない）
        //   §3.2: P1-C の alloc_delta は判定に使わない。prepare は呼ばない（P2-pre の禁止）。
        // ====================================================================
        convo::aligned_unique_ptr<AudioEngine::DSPCore> dspCore;
        {
            const unsigned threadsBefore = b2s1ThreadCount();
            const B2S1Counters before = b2s1Counters();

            dspCore = convo::aligned_make_unique<AudioEngine::DSPCore>();

            const bool releasedPreNonnull = (dspCore.get() != nullptr);
            const B2S1Counters after = b2s1Counters();
            const unsigned threadsAfter = b2s1ThreadCount();

            const std::uint64_t allocDelta = after.alloc - before.alloc;
            const std::uint64_t freedDelta = after.freed - before.freed;

            if (threadsBefore != threadsAfter && !degraded)
            {
                degraded = true;
                std::snprintf(degradedAt, sizeof(degradedAt), "P1-C");
            }

            std::printf("[B2S1] stage=P1-C stage_result=SKIP alloc_delta=%llu freed_delta=%llu"
                        " sizeof_dspcore=%llu nonnull=%d threads_before=%u threads_after=%u"
                        " note=informational_only\n",
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(allocDelta),
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(freedDelta),
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(sizeof(AudioEngine::DSPCore)),
                        releasedPreNonnull ? 1 : 0,
                        threadsBefore, threadsAfter);
            std::fflush(stdout);

            if (!releasedPreNonnull)
                return finish(11, "FAIL", "INVALID:SETUP", false);   // P2 の対象が無い
        }

        // ====================================================================
        // P2 — DSPCore の reset()（強ゲート: 0 / 0。P1-C と同一オブジェクトで連続実行）
        // ====================================================================
        {
            const unsigned threadsBefore = b2s1ThreadCount();
            const B2S1Counters before = b2s1Counters();

            const bool releasedPreNonnull = (dspCore.get() != nullptr);
            dspCore.reset();
            const bool pointerInvalidated = (dspCore.get() == nullptr);

            const B2S1Counters after = b2s1Counters();
            const unsigned threadsAfter = b2s1ThreadCount();

            const std::uint64_t allocDelta = after.alloc - before.alloc;
            const std::uint64_t freedDelta = after.freed - before.freed;
            const bool releaseInvoked = true;
            const int released = (releasedPreNonnull && releaseInvoked && pointerInvalidated) ? 1 : 0;

            if (threadsBefore != threadsAfter && !degraded)
            {
                degraded = true;
                std::snprintf(degradedAt, sizeof(degradedAt), "P2");
            }

            const bool counterOk = (allocDelta == 0 && freedDelta == 0 && released == 1);

            std::printf("[B2S1] stage=P2 stage_result=%s alloc_delta=%llu freed_delta=%llu"
                        " released_pre_nonnull=%d release_invoked=%d pointer_invalidated=%d"
                        " released=%d route=AlignedObjectDeleter threads_before=%u threads_after=%u\n",
                        counterOk ? "PASS" : "FAIL",
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(allocDelta),
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(freedDelta),
                        releasedPreNonnull ? 1 : 0, releaseInvoked ? 1 : 0,
                        pointerInvalidated ? 1 : 0, released,
                        threadsBefore, threadsAfter);
            std::fflush(stdout);

            if (released != 1)
                return finish(11, "FAIL", "INVALID:SETUP", false);
            if (!counterOk)
                return finish(5, "FAIL", "INVALID:STOP@5", false);
        }

        // ====================================================================
        // N1 — アイドルゲート（強ゲート。解放漏れの残響を検出する）
        // ====================================================================
        {
            const B2S1Counters before = b2s1Counters();
            const unsigned threadsBefore = b2s1ThreadCount();
            b2s1IdleWait();
            const B2S1Counters after = b2s1Counters();
            const unsigned threadsAfter = b2s1ThreadCount();

            const std::uint64_t idleAlloc = after.alloc - before.alloc;
            const std::uint64_t idleFreed = after.freed - before.freed;
            const bool counterOk = (idleAlloc == 0 && idleFreed == 0);
            const bool threadsOk = (threadsBefore == threadsAfter);

            std::printf("[B2S1] stage=N1 stage_result=%s idle_alloc_delta=%llu idle_freed_delta=%llu"
                        " threads_before=%u threads_after=%u\n",
                        (counterOk && threadsOk) ? "PASS" : "FAIL",
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(idleAlloc),
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(idleFreed),
                        threadsBefore, threadsAfter);
            std::fflush(stdout);

            if (!counterOk)
                return finish(6, "FAIL", "INVALID:STOP@6", false);
            if (!threadsOk)
                return finish(8, "PASS", "INVALID:STOP@8", false);
        }

        // ====================================================================
        // N2 — ゼロサイズ確保 → 解放（強ゲート: 0 / 0）
        //   size==0 の確保は正当に nullptr を返しうるため nothrow 版を使う。これは
        //   「0 バイト確保はカウンタを動かさない」というゲートの意味を変えない。
        // ====================================================================
        {
            const B2S1Counters before = b2s1Counters();
            const unsigned threadsBefore = b2s1ThreadCount();

            void* p = convo::aligned_malloc_nothrow(0, 64);
            const bool nonnull = (p != nullptr);
            convo::aligned_free(p);

            const B2S1Counters after = b2s1Counters();
            const unsigned threadsAfter = b2s1ThreadCount();

            const std::uint64_t allocDelta = after.alloc - before.alloc;
            const std::uint64_t freedDelta = after.freed - before.freed;

            if (threadsBefore != threadsAfter && !degraded)
            {
                degraded = true;
                std::snprintf(degradedAt, sizeof(degradedAt), "N2");
            }

            const bool counterOk = (allocDelta == 0 && freedDelta == 0);

            std::printf("[B2S1] stage=N2 stage_result=%s alloc_delta=%llu freed_delta=%llu"
                        " nonnull=%d threads_before=%u threads_after=%u\n",
                        counterOk ? "PASS" : "FAIL",
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(allocDelta),
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(freedDelta),
                        nonnull ? 1 : 0, threadsBefore, threadsAfter);
            std::fflush(stdout);

            if (!counterOk)
                return finish(7, "FAIL", "INVALID:STOP@7", false);
        }

        // ====================================================================
        // G9 — 後処理アイドルゲート。失敗すると系列全体が無効（§8.2 規則 1）。
        // ====================================================================
        {
            const B2S1Counters before = b2s1Counters();
            const unsigned threadsBefore = b2s1ThreadCount();
            b2s1IdleWait();
            const B2S1Counters after = b2s1Counters();
            const unsigned threadsAfter = b2s1ThreadCount();

            const std::uint64_t idleAlloc = after.alloc - before.alloc;
            const std::uint64_t idleFreed = after.freed - before.freed;
            const bool counterOk = (idleAlloc == 0 && idleFreed == 0);
            const bool threadsOk = (threadsBefore == threadsAfter);

            if (!counterOk)
                g9Failed = true;

            std::printf("[B2S1] stage=G9 stage_result=%s idle_alloc_delta=%llu idle_freed_delta=%llu"
                        " threads=%u threads_before=%u\n",
                        (counterOk && threadsOk) ? "PASS" : "FAIL",
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(idleAlloc),
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(idleFreed),
                        threadsAfter, threadsBefore);
            std::fflush(stdout);

            if (!counterOk)
                return finish(10, "FAIL", "INVALID:G9", false);
            if (!threadsOk)
                return finish(8, "PASS", "INVALID:STOP@8", false);
        }

        // 全ゲート通過。ただし「隔離性が観測された」場合に限り採用適格（§10.2）。
        return finish(0, "PASS", "VALID", true);
    }
    catch (const std::bad_alloc&)
    {
        // 停止条件 11: 確保失敗。aligned_malloc は nullptr ではなく std::bad_alloc を投げる。
        std::printf("[B2S1] setup_error=std::bad_alloc\n");
        std::fflush(stdout);
        return finish(11, "FAIL", "INVALID:SETUP", false);
    }
    catch (...)
    {
        std::printf("[B2S1] setup_error=unknown_exception\n");
        std::fflush(stdout);
        return finish(11, "FAIL", "INVALID:SETUP", false);
    }
}
