    ++g_testCount;
    ++g_failCount;
}

// 整数の一致をチェック
void checkEq(const char* name, uint64_t expected, uint64_t actual)
{
    if (expected == actual)
        testPass(name);
    else {
        char buf[128];
        std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "expected %llu, got %llu",
                      static_cast<unsigned long long>(expected),
                      static_cast<unsigned long long>(actual));
        testFail(name, buf);
    }
}

void checkTrue(const char* name, bool condition)
{
    if (condition)
        testPass(name);
    else
        testFail(name, "condition was false");
}

void checkFalse(const char* name, bool condition)
{
    if (!condition)
        testPass(name);
    else
        testFail(name, "condition was true");
}

//==============================================================================
// テスト補助: ダミーのポインタとデリーター
//==============================================================================
// 解放されたポインタを記録するための構造体
struct DeletionLog {
    std::vector<void*> deleted;
    std::mutex mutex;

    void record(void* ptr) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
        deleted.push_back(ptr);
    }

    bool wasDeleted(void* ptr) const {
        return std::find(deleted.begin(), deleted.end(), ptr) != deleted.end();
    }

    int count() const { return static_cast<int>(deleted.size()); }
    void clear() { deleted.clear(); }
};

// 破棄イベントを追跡可能なダミーオブジェクト
struct TrackedObject {
    int id;
    TrackedObject(int id) : id(id) {}
};

DeletionLog g_delLog;

void dummyDeleter(void* p)
{
    g_delLog.record(p);
}

void resetDeletionLog()
{
    g_delLog.clear();
}

//==============================================================================
// テスト 1: 基本 enqueue + reclaim（同一 epoch）
//==============================================================================
bool testBasicEnqueueReclaim()
{
    resetDeletionLog();
    DeferredDeletionQueue queue;

    TrackedObject obj1(1), obj2(2), obj3(3);

    // 同一 epoch (1) で 3 エントリ enqueue
    checkTrue("basic: enqueue 1", queue.enqueue(&obj1, dummyDeleter, 1, convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown));
    checkTrue("basic: enqueue 2", queue.enqueue(&obj2, dummyDeleter, 1, convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown));
    checkTrue("basic: enqueue 3", queue.enqueue(&obj3, dummyDeleter, 1, convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown));

    // epoch=1 より古い minReaderEpoch=2 で reclaim → 全件回収されるはず
    uint32_t reclaimed = queue.reclaim(2);
    checkEq("basic: reclaimed count", 3, reclaimed);
    checkTrue("basic: obj1 deleted", g_delLog.wasDeleted(&obj1));
    checkTrue("basic: obj2 deleted", g_delLog.wasDeleted(&obj2));
    checkTrue("basic: obj3 deleted", g_delLog.wasDeleted(&obj3));

    // 2回目の reclaim では何も回収されない
    reclaimed = queue.reclaim(2);
    checkEq("basic: second reclaim", 0, reclaimed);

    return g_failCount == 0; // テスト継続のため常に true を返す
}

//==============================================================================
// テスト 2: FIFO 順序保証
//==============================================================================
bool testFifoOrder()
{
    resetDeletionLog();
    DeferredDeletionQueue queue;

    TrackedObject obj1(1), obj2(2), obj3(3);

    queue.enqueue(&obj1, dummyDeleter, 1, convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown);
    queue.enqueue(&obj2, dummyDeleter, 1, convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown);
    queue.enqueue(&obj3, dummyDeleter, 1, convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown);

    // epoch=1 より古い minReaderEpoch=2 で reclaim
    uint32_t reclaimed = queue.reclaim(2);
    checkEq("fifo: reclaimed count", 3, reclaimed);

    // FIFO 順で削除されていること
    checkTrue("fifo: obj1 deleted first", g_delLog.wasDeleted(&obj1));
    checkTrue("fifo: obj2 deleted second", g_delLog.wasDeleted(&obj2));
    checkTrue("fifo: obj3 deleted third", g_delLog.wasDeleted(&obj3));

    return true;
}

//==============================================================================
// テスト 3: 異種 epoch — 古いものだけ回収される
//==============================================================================
bool testMixedEpochReclaim()
{
    resetDeletionLog();
    DeferredDeletionQueue queue;

    TrackedObject oldObj(1), newObj(2);

    queue.enqueue(&oldObj, dummyDeleter, 1, convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown);  // epoch=1
    queue.enqueue(&newObj, dummyDeleter, 5, convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown);  // epoch=5

    // minReaderEpoch=3 → epoch=1 は回収可能、epoch=5 は回収不可（先頭ブロッキング）
    uint32_t reclaimed = queue.reclaim(3);
    // ★ 現状の実装: 先頭 (oldObj, epoch=1) は回収可能なので回収される。
    //   その後 deqPos が進み、先頭が newObj (epoch=5) になる。
    //   newObj は回収不可なので break。よって reclaimed=1。
    //   ※ これが Bug#5 の「先読み非搭載」の現状動作。先読みがあれば newObj も
    //     別の機会に回収されるが、今は not reclaimable で即 break.
    checkEq("mixed: reclaimed count", 1, reclaimed);
    checkTrue("mixed: old obj deleted", g_delLog.wasDeleted(&oldObj));
    checkFalse("mixed: new obj NOT deleted", g_delLog.wasDeleted(&newObj));

    // 2回目: 同じ minReaderEpoch=3 → newObj(epoch=5) はまだ回収不可
    reclaimed = queue.reclaim(3);
    checkEq("mixed: second reclaim (still blocked)", 0, reclaimed);

    // 3回目: minReaderEpoch=7 → newObj も回収可能
    reclaimed = queue.reclaim(7);
    checkEq("mixed: third reclaim (unblocked)", 1, reclaimed);
    checkTrue("mixed: new obj now deleted", g_delLog.wasDeleted(&newObj));

    return true;
}

//==============================================================================
// テスト 4: 先頭ブロッキング — 新しい epoch が先頭にあると後続をブロック
//==============================================================================
bool testHeadBlocking()
{
    resetDeletionLog();
    DeferredDeletionQueue queue;

    TrackedObject blocker(1), blocked(2);

    queue.enqueue(&blocker, dummyDeleter, 10, convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown); // epoch=10（新しい）
    queue.enqueue(&blocked, dummyDeleter, 1, convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown);  // epoch=1（古いが後ろ） ← 逆転！

    // minReaderEpoch=5 → blocker(epoch=10) が先頭で回収不可
    // ★ 現状の実装: else 節 → !canDelete → break。blocked は後続にいるが回収されない
    uint32_t reclaimed = queue.reclaim(5);
    checkEq("head-blocking: reclaimed (blocked)", 0, reclaimed);
    checkFalse("head-blocking: blocker NOT deleted", g_delLog.wasDeleted(&blocker));
    checkFalse("head-blocking: blocked NOT deleted", g_delLog.wasDeleted(&blocked));

    // blocker が古くなったら回収可能
    reclaimed = queue.reclaim(12);
    checkEq("head-blocking: reclaim after blocker aged", 2, reclaimed);
    checkTrue("head-blocking: blocker deleted", g_delLog.wasDeleted(&blocker));
    checkTrue("head-blocking: blocked deleted", g_delLog.wasDeleted(&blocked));

    return true;
}

//==============================================================================
// テスト 5: reclaim 返戻値の正確性（連続 reclaim）
//==============================================================================
bool testReclaimCountAccuracy()
{
    resetDeletionLog();
    DeferredDeletionQueue queue;

    // ★ ヒープ確保したオブジェクトを使用（vector の再確保によるポインタ無効化を回避）
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<TrackedObject>> objs;
    objs.reserve(100);
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; ++i) {
        auto obj = std::make_unique<TrackedObject>(i);
        queue.enqueue(obj.get(), dummyDeleter, 1, convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown);
        objs.push_back(std::move(obj));
    }

    // 全件 epoch=1, minReaderEpoch=2 で全件回収
    uint32_t reclaimed = queue.reclaim(2);
    checkEq("count: all 100 reclaimed", 100, reclaimed);

    // 全件削除されたことを確認
    for (auto& ptr : objs) {
        if (!g_delLog.wasDeleted(ptr.get())) {
            char buf[64];
            std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "obj %d not deleted", ptr->id);
            testFail("count: all deleted", buf);
            return true;
        }
    }
    testPass("count: all objects deleted");

    // 2回目: 空キュー
    reclaimed = queue.reclaim(2);
    checkEq("count: empty queue reclaim", 0, reclaimed);

    // さらに追加して部分回収（スタック変数、get() 不使用）
    TrackedObject partial1(200), partial2(201);
    queue.enqueue(&partial1, dummyDeleter, 1, convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown);
    queue.enqueue(&partial2, dummyDeleter, 10, convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown); // 新しい

    reclaimed = queue.reclaim(5);
    checkEq("count: partial reclaim (only old)", 1, reclaimed);
    checkTrue("count: partial1 deleted", g_delLog.wasDeleted(&partial1));
    checkFalse("count: partial2 NOT deleted", g_delLog.wasDeleted(&partial2));

    reclaimed = queue.reclaim(15);
    checkEq("count: remaining reclaimed", 1, reclaimed);
    checkTrue("count: partial2 now deleted", g_delLog.wasDeleted(&partial2));

    return true;
}

//==============================================================================
// テスト 6: 空キューでの reclaim
//==============================================================================
bool testEmptyQueueReclaim()
{
    resetDeletionLog();
    DeferredDeletionQueue queue;

    uint32_t reclaimed = queue.reclaim(100);
    checkEq("empty: reclaim on empty queue", 0, reclaimed);

    // 空キューに enqueue して即 reclaim
    TrackedObject obj(1);
    queue.enqueue(&obj, dummyDeleter, 1, convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown);
    reclaimed = queue.reclaim(2);
    checkEq("empty: single then reclaim", 1, reclaimed);

    return true;
}

//==============================================================================
// テスト 7: MPMC epoch 逆転シナリオ（複数スレッド同時 enqueue）
//
// ■ 目的
//   DeferredDeletionQueue は MPMC（複数 Producer / 複数 Consumer）を謳っている。
//   複数スレッドが独立に取得した epoch を同時に enqueue したとき、
//   キュー内で epoch の順序が逆転する現象が実際に発生するかを測定する。
//
// ■ 測定方法
//   1. N スレッドがそれぞれ異なる epoch 範囲で一斉に enqueue する
//   2. スレッドごとに異なる epoch オフセットを割り当てる
//   3. 全スレッド完了後に reclaim() を実行
//   4. reclaim() が返した件数と、実際に回収可能なエントリ数を比較
//   5. 差があれば epoch 逆転が発生した証拠（ただし先頭ブロッキングの影響も含む）
//
// ■ 測定指標
//   - inversionDetected: 逆転が疑われる状況が発生したか
//   - skipCount: reclaim が見逃した回収可能エントリ数
//   - scanBudgetExhausted: 1回の reclaim 呼び出しで kMaxScan=1024 に達したか
//==============================================================================
struct MpmcEpochInversionResult {
    bool inversionDetected = false;
    int skipCount = 0;
    int scanBudgetExhaustedCount = 0;
    int totalReclaimableEntries = 0;
    int totalReclaimed = 0;
    double reclaimRatio = 1.0; // totalReclaimed / totalReclaimableEntries
};

MpmcEpochInversionResult testMpmcEpochInversion(int numProducers,
                                                 int entriesPerProducer,
                                                 int epochSpread)
{
    DeferredDeletionQueue queue;
    std::atomic<int> readyCount{0};
    std::atomic<bool> startSignal{false};

    // 全スレッドが一斉に enqueue するためのバリア
    auto barrier = [&]() {
        convo::fetchAddAtomic(readyCount, 1, std::memory_order_release);
        while (!convo::consumeAtomic(startSignal, std::memory_order_acquire)) {
            std::this_thread::yield();
        }
    };

    // 全 Producer スレッド生成
    std::vector<std::thread> producers;
    std::vector<TrackedObject*> allObjs;
    std::mutex objMutex;

    for (int p = 0; p < numProducers; ++p) {
        producers.emplace_back([&, p]() {
            barrier(); // 一斉スタート

            for (int i = 0; i < entriesPerProducer; ++i) {
                auto* obj = new TrackedObject(p * 10000 + i);
                {
                    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(objMutex);
                    allObjs.push_back(obj);
                }
                // Producer ごとに異なる epoch 範囲を割り当て
                uint64_t epoch = static_cast<uint64_t>(p * epochSpread + i);
                queue.enqueue(obj, [](void* ptr) {
                    delete static_cast<TrackedObject*>(ptr);
                }, epoch, convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown);
            }
        });
    }

    // 一斉スタート
    while (convo::consumeAtomic(readyCount, std::memory_order_acquire) < numProducers) {
        std::this_thread::yield();
    }
    convo::publishAtomic(startSignal, true, std::memory_order_release);

    for (auto& t : producers) {
        t.join();
    }

    // ★ 測定: 全エントリが epoch 最大値より古い状態で reclaim
    //   最も新しい epoch を計算
    uint64_t maxEpoch = 0;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(objMutex);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < allObjs.size(); ++i) {
            // epoch は p * epochSpread + i の形式。最大値を計算
            int p = i / entriesPerProducer;
            int idx = i % entriesPerProducer;
            uint64_t epoch = static_cast<uint64_t>(p * epochSpread + idx);
            if (epoch > maxEpoch) maxEpoch = epoch;
        }
    }

    // minReaderEpoch = maxEpoch + 1 で全エントリ回収可能な状態で reclaim
    uint64_t minReaderEpoch = maxEpoch + 1;
    uint32_t reclaimed = queue.reclaim(minReaderEpoch);

    MpmcEpochInversionResult result;
    result.totalReclaimableEntries = numProducers * entriesPerProducer;
    result.totalReclaimed = static_cast<int>(reclaimed);
    result.reclaimRatio = result.totalReclaimableEntries > 0
        ? static_cast<double>(result.totalReclaimed) / static_cast<double>(result.totalReclaimableEntries)
        : 1.0;
    result.skipCount = result.totalReclaimableEntries - result.totalReclaimed;
    result.inversionDetected = (result.skipCount > 0);
    // 最大値scanned の代わりに skip 率で間接測定
    result.scanBudgetExhaustedCount = result.skipCount;

    // 残ったエントリを解放 (drainAllUnsafe)
    queue.drainAllUnsafe();

    // allObjs のクリーンアップ（drainAllUnsafe で削除済みのため解放不要）
    for (auto* obj : allObjs) {
        (void)obj; // drainAllUnsafe が削除している
    }

    return result;
}

// MPMC テストのランナー（複数条件で実行）
void runMpmcEpochInversionTests()
{
    std::cout << "\n  --- MPMC Epoch Inversion Measurement ---" << std::endl;

    struct TestCase {
        const char* name;
        int producers;
        int entriesPerProducer;
        int epochSpread;
    };

    TestCase cases[] = {
        {"2 producers, 100 entries, spread=1",    2,   100, 1},
        {"4 producers, 100 entries, spread=1",    4,   100, 1},
        {"2 producers, 1000 entries, spread=1",   2,  1000, 1},
        {"4 producers, 500 entries, spread=1",    4,   500, 1},
        {"2 producers, 100 entries, spread=10",   2,   100, 10},
        {"4 producers, 100 entries, spread=100",  4,   100, 100},
        {"8 producers, 100 entries, spread=1",    8,   100, 1},
        {"8 producers, 500 entries, spread=10",   8,   500, 10},
    };

    for (const auto& tc : cases) {
        auto result = testMpmcEpochInversion(tc.producers,
                                              tc.entriesPerProducer,
                                              tc.epochSpread);

        // ★ FIX: g_ioMutex は testPass/testFail 内部でロックされるため、
        //   ここでは不要。二重ロックによるデッドロックを防止する。
        std::cout << "  " << tc.name << ": "
                  << "reclaimed=" << result.totalReclaimed
                  << "/" << result.totalReclaimableEntries
                  << " (" << (result.reclaimRatio * 100.0) << "%)"
                  << " skip=" << result.skipCount;
        if (result.inversionDetected) {
            std::cout << " WARNING INVERSION DETECTED";
        } else {
            std::cout << " OK no inversion";
        }
        std::cout << std::endl;

        if (result.inversionDetected) {
            testFail("mpmc: epoch inversion detected (see measurement above)");
        } else {
            testPass("mpmc: no epoch inversion in this configuration");
        }
    }
}

//==============================================================================
// テスト 8: ストレステスト（高スループット concurrent enqueue + reclaim）
//
// ■ 目的
//   長時間・高頻度の enqueue/reclaim サイクルで動作安定性を検証する。
//   kQueueSize=4096 という制約の中で、キュー飽和・空・通常状態を繰り返す。
//
// ■ 測定方法
//   1. Producer スレッド群が一定レートで enqueue を継続
//   2. Consumer (reclaimer) スレッドが定期的に reclaim() を呼ぶ
//   3. 規定時間経過後、全スレッド停止
//   4. drainAllUnsafe() で残余エントリを回収
//   5. 全 Producer からの enqueue 数と Consumer の reclaim 数の一致を確認
//==============================================================================
struct StressTestResult {
    // NOLINT(atomic-dot-call): テスト専用の診断カウンタ。convo::fetchAddAtomic は使用せず直接 atomic 操作
    std::atomic<uint64_t> totalEnqueued{0};
    std::atomic<uint64_t> totalReclaimed{0};
    std::atomic<uint64_t> totalEnqueueFailures{0};
    std::atomic<uint64_t> maxReclaimLatencyUs{0};
    bool passed = false;
};

void runStressTest(int durationMs)
{
    std::cout << "\n  --- Stress Test (" << durationMs << "ms) ---" << std::endl;

    DeferredDeletionQueue queue;
    StressTestResult result;
    std::atomic<bool> stopFlag{false};

    constexpr int kNumProducers = 4;
    constexpr int kReclaimIntervalUs = 500; // 500us

    // Producer スレッド（epoch をインクリメントしながら enqueue）
    std::vector<std::thread> producers;
    for (int p = 0; p < kNumProducers; ++p) {
        producers.emplace_back([&, p]() {
            uint64_t baseEpoch = static_cast<uint64_t>(p) * 1000000ULL;
            uint64_t counter = 0;
            while (!convo::consumeAtomic(stopFlag, std::memory_order_acquire)) {
                auto* obj = new TrackedObject(p * 100000 + static_cast<int>(counter % 100000));
                uint64_t epoch = baseEpoch + counter;
                if (queue.enqueue(obj, [](void* ptr) {
                        delete static_cast<TrackedObject*>(ptr);
                    }, epoch, convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown)) {
                    convo::fetchAddAtomic(result.totalEnqueued, uint64_t{1}, std::memory_order_release);
                } else {
                    delete obj;
                    convo::fetchAddAtomic(result.totalEnqueueFailures, uint64_t{1}, std::memory_order_release);
                }
                ++counter;
                // Producer ごとに適度なペース
                if (counter % 100 == 0) {
                    std::this_thread::yield();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    // Reclaimer スレッド（定期的に reclaim）
    std::thread reclaimer([&]() {
        uint64_t currentEpoch = 1;
        while (!convo::consumeAtomic(stopFlag, std::memory_order_acquire)) {
            auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
            uint32_t reclaimed = queue.reclaim(currentEpoch);
            auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
            uint64_t latencyUs = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(
                end - start).count();

            convo::fetchAddAtomic(result.totalReclaimed, static_cast<uint64_t>(reclaimed), std::memory_order_release);

            // 最大レイテンシを更新
            uint64_t prev = convo::consumeAtomic(result.maxReclaimLatencyUs, std::memory_order_acquire);
            while (latencyUs > prev) {
                if (convo::compareExchangeAtomic(result.maxReclaimLatencyUs,
                        prev, latencyUs, std::memory_order_release, std::memory_order_acquire))
                    break;
            }

            currentEpoch += 1000; // epoch を進める
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::microseconds(kReclaimIntervalUs));
        }
    });

    // 規定時間実行
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(durationMs));
    convo::publishAtomic(stopFlag, true, std::memory_order_release);

    // 全スレッド完了待ち
    for (auto& t : producers) t.join();
    reclaimer.join();

    // 残余エントリを回収（drainAllUnsafe は void 戻り値）
    uint32_t preDrainReclaimed = static_cast<uint32_t>(convo::consumeAtomic(result.totalReclaimed, std::memory_order_acquire));
    queue.drainAllUnsafe();
    // ★ drainAllUnsafe は戻り値を返さないため、reclaim 後の残余カウントは不明。
    //   代わりに「後続の reclaim で残ゼロ」であることの確認は省略し、
    //   少なくとも preDrainReclaimed までのエントリが正しく回収され、
    //   残余は drainAllUnsafe がすべて解放したと見なす。
    uint64_t totalReclaimed = preDrainReclaimed;
    uint64_t totalEnqueued = convo::consumeAtomic(result.totalEnqueued, std::memory_order_acquire);

    // ★ FIX: testPass/testFail が内部で g_ioMutex をロックするため、
    //   ここでは生の std::cout 出力のみ行い、チェックはロック外で行う。
    bool stressPassed = false;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_ioMutex);
        std::cout << "  Stress: enqueued=" << totalEnqueued
                  << " reclaimed=" << totalReclaimed
                  << " enqFail=" << convo::consumeAtomic(result.totalEnqueueFailures, std::memory_order_acquire)
                  << " maxLatencyUs=" << convo::consumeAtomic(result.maxReclaimLatencyUs, std::memory_order_acquire)
                  << std::endl;

        if (convo::consumeAtomic(result.totalEnqueueFailures, std::memory_order_relaxed) > 0) {
            std::cout << "  Queue was FULL during stress test ("
                      << convo::consumeAtomic(result.totalEnqueueFailures, std::memory_order_relaxed) << " enqueue failures)"
                      << std::endl;
        }

        stressPassed = (totalEnqueued > 0);
    } // g_ioMutex のロックを解放してから testPass/testFail を呼ぶ

    if (stressPassed) {
        testPass("stress: enqueue/reclaim cycle completed");
    } else {
        testFail("stress: no entries were enqueued");
    }
}

//==============================================================================
// テスト 9: kMaxScan 到達テスト — 大量 reclaimable エントリの一括回収
//
// kMaxScan=1024 の制限を確認。1回の reclaim() で 1024 エントリ以上回収できること
// （scan budget は先読み用であり、回収自体に上限はないため）。
//==============================================================================
bool testMaxScanBudget()
{
    resetDeletionLog();
    DeferredDeletionQueue queue;

    // ★ kQueueSize=4096 がキューの上限のため、kNumEntries は kQueueSize 以下にする
    constexpr int kNumEntries = 4096;

    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<TrackedObject>> objs;
    objs.reserve(kNumEntries);
    for (int i = 0; i < kNumEntries; ++i) {
        auto obj = std::make_unique<TrackedObject>(i);
        queue.enqueue(obj.get(), dummyDeleter, 1, convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown);
        objs.push_back(std::move(obj));
    }

    // 1回の reclaim() で全件回収できるはず（kMaxScan は先読み用であり回収自体に上限なし）
    uint32_t reclaimed = queue.reclaim(2);
    checkEq("maxscan: all entries reclaimed in one call", kNumEntries, reclaimed);

    return true;
}

//==============================================================================
// テスト 10: エントリ数が多いときの reclaim パフォーマンス測定
//==============================================================================
void testReclaimPerformance()
{
    std::cout << "\n  --- Reclaim Performance Measurement ---" << std::endl;

    // ★ kQueueSize=4096 が上限。上限まで詰めて測定。
    constexpr int kNumEntries = 1024;

    DeferredDeletionQueue queue;
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<TrackedObject>> objs;
    objs.reserve(kNumEntries);
    for (int i = 0; i < kNumEntries; ++i) {
        auto obj = std::make_unique<TrackedObject>(i);
        queue.enqueue(obj.get(), dummyDeleter, 1, convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown);
        objs.push_back(std::move(obj));
    }

    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
    uint32_t reclaimed = queue.reclaim(2);
    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

    uint64_t elapsedUs = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(
        end - start).count();

    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_ioMutex);
        std::cout << "  Performance: reclaimed " << reclaimed
                  << " entries in " << elapsedUs << " us"
                  << " (" << (elapsedUs * 1000.0 / kNumEntries) << " ns/entry)"
                  << std::endl;
    }
    checkEq("perf: all reclaimed", kNumEntries, reclaimed);
}

} // anonymous namespace

//==============================================================================
// main
//==============================================================================
int main()
{
    std::cout << "==============================================" << std::endl;
    std::cout << "DeferredDeletionQueue Reclaim Tests" << std::endl;
    std::cout << "  (Bug#5 改修計画に基づく自動実測テスト)" << std::endl;
    std::cout << "==============================================" << std::endl;

    // ── 基本機能テスト ──
    std::cout << "\n[Basic Functionality Tests]" << std::endl;
    testBasicEnqueueReclaim();
    testFifoOrder();
    testMixedEpochReclaim();
    testHeadBlocking();
    testReclaimCountAccuracy();
    testEmptyQueueReclaim();
    testMaxScanBudget();

    // ── パフォーマンス測定 ──
    std::cout << "\n[Performance Measurement]" << std::endl;
    testReclaimPerformance();

    // ── MPMC epoch 逆転測定 ──
    std::cout << "\n[MPMC Epoch Inversion Measurement]" << std::endl;
    runMpmcEpochInversionTests();

    // ── ストレステスト ──
    std::cout << "\n[Stress Test]" << std::endl;
    runStressTest(3000); // 3秒間

    // ── 結果 ──
    std::cout << "\n==============================================" << std::endl;
    std::cout << "Results: " << g_testCount << " tests, "
              << g_failCount << " failures" << std::endl;
    std::cout << "==============================================" << std::endl;

    return g_failCount > 0 ? 1 : 0;
}

std::uint64_t nowNs()

    return static_cast<std::uint64_t> (
        duration_cast<nanoseconds> (steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count());
}

// #15-c 用: 実 ctor に不正値を渡し、SEH で捕捉できるかを見る

void constructInvalidInSeh()
{

    // 静的ストレージへ placement new して、巻き戻し対象のオブジェクトを作らない。
    alignas (convo::EpochDomain) static unsigned char storage[sizeof (convo::EpochDomain)];

    __try
    {
        ::new (static_cast<void*> (storage)) convo::EpochDomain (convo::RetireDomainId::Count);
    }
    __except (EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER)
    {
        g_caught = true;
        g_code = GetExceptionCode();
    }
}

void testRecorderInvariants()   // #6 / #8 / #13
{
    std::printf ("[#6/#8/#13] ドメイン別集計の不変条件\n");

    auto& rec = convo::isr::RetireLatencyRecorder::instance();
    rec.reset();

    // ドメイン別に 4 完了を作る（EngineISR=classified, EQ=excluded, Unknown=unclassified, Unstamped=excluded）
    static int objs[4];

    struct Case { int* obj; convo::RetireDomainId domain; convo::isr::RetireLatencyRecorder::Path path; int mode; };
    const Case cases[] = {
        { &objs[0], convo::RetireDomainId::EngineISR, convo::isr::RetireLatencyRecorder::Path::Queue,      2 },
        { &objs[1], convo::RetireDomainId::EQ,        convo::isr::RetireLatencyRecorder::Path::Drain,      0 },
        { &objs[2], convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown,   convo::isr::RetireLatencyRecorder::Path::Sync,       1 },
        { &objs[3], convo::RetireDomainId::Unstamped, convo::isr::RetireLatencyRecorder::Path::Quarantine, 0 },
    };

    for (const auto& c : cases)
    {
        rec.recordRequest (c.obj, 1);
        std::uint64_t firstScan = 0;

        if (c.mode >= 1)
        {
            const std::uint64_t t = nowNs();
            rec.recordSafe (c.obj);
            if (c.mode == 2)
                firstScan = t;
        }

        rec.recordComplete (c.obj, c.path, c.domain, firstScan);
    }

    const auto snap = rec.snapshot();
    const auto& tot = snap.classTotals;

    std::uint64_t sumCount = 0, sumClassified = 0, sumUnclassified = 0, sumExcluded = 0, sumConsistency = 0;

    for (int d = 0; d < convo::kRetireDomainCount; ++d)
    {
        sumCount += snap.domains[d].count;
        sumClassified += snap.domains[d].classified;
        sumUnclassified += snap.domains[d].unclassified;
        sumExcluded += snap.domains[d].excluded;
        sumConsistency += snap.domains[d].consistencyErrors;
    }

    check (sumCount == tot.completions, "sum(domains.count) == totals.completions");
    check (sumClassified == tot.classified, "sum(domains.classified) == totals.classified");
    check (sumUnclassified == tot.unclassified, "sum(domains.unclassified) == totals.unclassified");
    check (sumExcluded == tot.excluded, "sum(domains.excluded) == totals.excluded");
    check (sumConsistency == tot.consistencyErrors, "sum(domains.consistencyErrors) == totals.consistencyErrors");
    check (tot.classified + tot.unclassified + tot.excluded == tot.completions,
           "classified + unclassified + excluded == completions");

    // 原因の分離
    check (snap.domains[static_cast<int> (convo::RetireDomainId::Unstamped)].count == snap.stampMissing,
           "domains[Unstamped].count == stampMissing");
    check (snap.domains[static_cast<int> (convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown)].count
               == snap.providerUnknown + snap.providerAbsent,
           "domains[Unknown].count == providerUnknown + providerAbsent");
    check (snap.providerAbsent == 0, "providerAbsent == 0 (防御的・到達不能)");

    // Unknown の非混入（EngineISR / EQ はそれぞれ 1 件だけ）
    check (snap.domains[static_cast<int> (convo::RetireDomainId::EngineISR)].count == 1,
           "EngineISR count == 1 (Unknown が混入していない)");
    check (snap.domains[static_cast<int> (convo::RetireDomainId::EQ)].count == 1,
           "EQ count == 1 (Unknown が混入していない)");
    check (snap.stampMissing == 1, "stampMissing counts the Unstamped completion");

    // パス別の成分も一致するか（JSON の domainSumsConsistent と同じ検査）
    bool pathSumsOk = true;

    for (std::size_t p = 0; p < convo::isr::RetireLatencyRecorder::kPathCount; ++p)
    {
        std::uint64_t driver = 0, ebr = 0, exec = 0, unclassified = 0, excluded = 0;

        for (int d = 0; d < convo::kRetireDomainCount; ++d)
        {
            driver += snap.domains[d].paths[p].driverWait.count;
            ebr += snap.domains[d].paths[p].ebrWait.count;
            exec += snap.domains[d].paths[p].execWait.count;
            unclassified += snap.domains[d].paths[p].unclassifiedCount;
            excluded += snap.domains[d].paths[p].excludedCount;
        }

        if (driver != snap.classifiedPaths[p].driverWait.count
            || ebr != snap.classifiedPaths[p].ebrWait.count
            || exec != snap.classifiedPaths[p].execWait.count
            || unclassified != snap.classifiedPaths[p].unclassifiedCount
            || excluded != snap.classifiedPaths[p].excludedCount)
            pathSumsOk = false;
    }

    check (pathSumsOk, "Σ domains[].paths[p].<component> == paths[p].<component>");
    check (snap.domains[static_cast<int> (convo::RetireDomainId::EngineISR)].classified == 1,
           "EngineISR classified == 1");
}

void testCompatibilityAndSizes()   // #9 / #10
{
    std::printf ("[#9/#10] 既存互換とサイズ\n");

    static_assert (convo::isr::RetireLatencyRecorder::kThresholdNs == 50'000'000ull,
                   "50 ms 閾値は変更しない");

                   "パス数は 6 のまま（キー構造の互換）");

    check (alignof (DeletionEntry) == 8, "alignof(DeletionEntry) == 8");

    check (std::is_trivially_destructible_v<DeletionEntry>, "DeletionEntry is trivially destructible");

### 📄 `src\tests\DrainContractTests.cpp`

```
//==============================================================================
// DrainContractTests.cpp — WORK113 Queue/Gate/Drain の契約テスト（単一 TU・テスト専用）
//
//   - publish gate の期限判定（active 中の waitForIdle は false、close 後の入場拒否）
//   - reader fence / reader admission（register / reserve / reacquire の拒否と計数）
//   - reader admission と shutdown の競合（fence 閉鎖中に admission 中の reader がいる）
//   - drainQueue の判定（reader 非静止・capability 不正・epoch 不一致・完了）
//   - capability の single-use
//   - 隔離の一意化と自己参照保持（非空 queue・deleter は実行しない）
//   - checked drain の deleter exactly-once（非空 queue・失敗時は保持）
//
//   本ファイルは CONVOPEQ_ENABLE_DRAIN_TEST_FACTORY=1 でビルドされ、
//   DrainCapability::makeForTest() だけが本番ヘッダに現れる（本番ビルドには存在しない）。
//   makeForTest は EpochDomain の下位契約（drainQueue）の検証にだけ使う。
//   ShutdownRuntime の発行経路は invariant_INV3_INV5Tests が実 API で検証する。
//==============================================================================

#include "core/EpochDomain.h"
#include "core/DrainCapability.h"

#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <memory>
#include <thread>

namespace
{

using namespace std::chrono_literals;

int g_failures = 0;
std::atomic<int> g_deleted { 0 };

void countingDeleter (void*) { g_deleted.fetch_add (1, std::memory_order_relaxed); }

void check (bool ok, const char* what)
{
    if (! ok)
    {
        std::fprintf (stderr, "[drain-test] FAIL: %s\n", what);
        ++g_failures;
    }
}

void waitUntil (const std::atomic<bool>& flag)
{
    while (! flag.load (std::memory_order_acquire))
        std::this_thread::yield();
}

// ★ 上限付きの待機。タイムアウトは false。
//   チェックポイントに到達しない回帰でテストがハングしないように使う。
bool waitUntilBounded (const std::atomic<bool>& flag, std::chrono::milliseconds timeout)
{
    const auto deadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + timeout;
    while (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < deadline)
    {
        if (flag.load (std::memory_order_acquire))
            return true;
        std::this_thread::sleep_for (std::chrono::microseconds (100));
    }
    return flag.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
}

void testPublishGate()
{
    convo::EpochDomain::EpochPublishGate gate;

    check (gate.tryEnter(), "gate: tryEnter while open");
    gate.close();

    // active publisher が残っている間は、期限内の idle を観測できない。
    check (! gate.waitForIdle (std::chrono::milliseconds (50)),
           "gate: waitForIdle must time out while a publisher is active");

    // close 後の新規入場は拒否される。
    check (! gate.tryEnter(), "gate: tryEnter after close must fail");

    gate.exit();
    check (gate.waitForIdle (std::chrono::milliseconds (50)),
           "gate: waitForIdle must succeed after exit");
}

void testReaderFence (convo::EpochDomain& domain)
{
    domain.engageShutdownReaderFence();

    check (domain.registerReaderThread ("drain-test") == -1,
           "fence: registerReaderThread must be refused");
    check (! domain.reserveReaderThread (0),
           "fence: reserveReaderThread must be refused");
    check (! domain.reacquireReaderSlot (0),
           "fence: reacquireReaderSlot must be refused");
    check (domain.enterAfterFence() >= 2u, "fence: enterAfterFence counter");
    check (domain.reacquireAfterFence() >= 1u, "fence: reacquireAfterFence counter");

    // fence は reader の入場だけを止める。NonRT の enqueue は継続できる。
    static int sentinel = 0;
    auto noopDeleter = [] (void*) noexcept {};
    check (domain.enqueueRetire (&sentinel, noopDeleter, domain.currentEpoch()),
           "fence: enqueueRetire must still succeed");
    domain.drainAll();
}

//==============================================================================
// shutdown の強制解放除外（retire drain exclusion）
//   除外中は再入場を拒否し、解除後は従来どおり再入場できること。
//   fence（永久）とは異なり、V11 E1 の規則を壊さないことを固定する。
//==============================================================================
void testRetireDrainExclusion()
{
    auto domain = std::make_unique<convo::EpochDomain> (convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown);

    const int slot = domain->registerReaderThread ("drain-exclusion");
    check (slot >= 0, "exclusion: registerReaderThread must succeed before close");
    if (slot < 0)
        return;

    // registerReaderThread が予約（admission）を保持しているので、そのまま enter する。
    // 一度 exit すれば slot は inactive に戻り、reacquire 可能になる。
    domain->enterReader (slot);
    domain->exitReader (slot);

    // ★ 実際の shutdown と同じ状態にする：新規登録は閉じ、登録済み slot の再入場は可能。
    //   登録が開いたままだと、再入場が登録経由で成功しても差が出ない。
    domain->closeReaderRegistration();

    domain->beginRetireDrainExclusion();
    check (domain->retireDrainExclusionActive(), "exclusion: flag must be visible");
    check (! domain->reacquireReaderSlot (slot),
           "exclusion: reacquireReaderSlot must be refused during the exclusion");
    check (domain->reacquireDuringDrainExclusion() >= 1u,
           "exclusion: refusal must be counted");
    check (domain->readerAdmissionsActive() == 0u,
           "exclusion: a refused reacquire must not hold an admission");
    // ★ 拒否直後に予約が残っていないこと。後の enter が消すので、
    //   実行を待ってから確かめると見逃してしまう。
    check (domain->admissionPendingSlots() == 0u,
           "exclusion: a refused reacquire must not leave a pending slot");

    domain->endRetireDrainExclusion();
    check (! domain->retireDrainExclusionActive(), "exclusion: flag must clear");

    const bool reacquired = domain->reacquireReaderSlot (slot);
    check (reacquired, "exclusion: reacquireReaderSlot must succeed after the exclusion ends");
    if (reacquired)
    {
        // reacquire は slot を depth 0 で予約し、admission を保持したままである。
        // enter せずに exit すると、admission が残って下流の静止判定を壊す。
        domain->enterReader (slot);
        check (domain->activeDepthReaderCount() >= 1u,
               "exclusion: depth must be nonzero after enter");
        domain->exitReader (slot);
        check (domain->activeDepthReaderCount() == 0u,
               "exclusion: depth must return to 0 after exit");
        check (domain->readerAdmissionsActive() == 0u,
               "exclusion: no admission must remain after exit");
        check (domain->admissionPendingSlots() == 0u,
               "exclusion: no pending slot must remain after exit");
    }

    // 解除後も新規登録は拒否される（close は永久、再入場だけが復帰する）。
    check (domain->registerReaderThread ("drain-exclusion-2") == -1,
           "exclusion: new registration must stay refused after the exclusion ends");
}

//==============================================================================
// admission と shutdown の競合（決定論的 interleaving）
//   Reader が admission を取得した直後（fence 判定の前）に停止し、その間に
//   shutdown が fence / gate を閉じる。shutdown は入場処理の完了を待ち、
//   checked drain はその状態で成功しない。
//==============================================================================
struct SeamContext
{
    std::atomic<bool> reached { false };
    std::atomic<bool> release { false };
};

void admissionSeam (void* ctxPtr)
{
    auto* ctx = static_cast<SeamContext*> (ctxPtr);
    ctx->reached.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
    waitUntil (ctx->release);
}

void testAdmissionRace()
{
    auto domain = std::make_unique<convo::EpochDomain> (convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown);

    SeamContext ctx;
    std::atomic<int> slot { -1 };
    std::atomic<bool> registered { false };
    std::atomic<bool> reacquired { true };

    std::thread reader ([&]
    {
        const int idx = domain->registerReaderThread ("race");
        slot.store (idx, std::memory_order_release);
        registered.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
        if (idx < 0)
            return;

        domain->enterReader (idx);   // admission 終了（depth 1）
        domain->exitReader (idx);    // inactive（ownerThreadId は保持）

        domain->setReaderAdmissionSeam (&admissionSeam, &ctx);
        reacquired.store (domain->reacquireReaderSlot (idx), std::memory_order_release);
        domain->setReaderAdmissionSeam (nullptr, nullptr);
    });

    waitUntil (registered);
    waitUntil (ctx.reached);          // reader は admission 取得後・fence 判定前で停止

    // shutdown 側: fence / admission gate / publish gate を閉じる。
    domain->engageShutdownReaderFence();
    domain->closeReaderRegistration();

    // 入場処理中の reader が残っているため、静止確認は成立しない（待つ）。
    check (! domain->waitForReaderAdmissions (std::chrono::milliseconds (100)),
           "race: shutdown must wait for an in-flight reader admission");
    check (domain->readerAdmissionsActive() >= 1u, "race: in-flight admission is counted");
    check (domain->activeReaderCount() == 0, "race: in-flight admission is not an active reader");
    check (domain->closePublishersAndWaitIdle (std::chrono::milliseconds (50)),
           "race: publishers must become idle");

    auto queue = domain->borrow();
    check (queue != nullptr, "race: borrow");
    if (queue == nullptr)
    {
        ctx.release.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
        reader.join();
        return;
    }

    {
        auto cap = convo::DrainCapability::makeForTest (true, true, true, true,
                                                        domain->epochAtFence(), 1, 1);
        check (domain->drainQueue (*queue, std::move (cap))
                   == convo::EpochDomain::DrainResult::ReadersNotQuiescent,
               "race: checked drain must fail while a reader admission is in flight");
    }

    // reader を再開する。fence は閉じているため入場できない。
    ctx.release.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
    reader.join();

    check (! reacquired.load(), "race: reader must be refused after the fence closed");
    check (domain->reacquireAfterFence() >= 1u, "race: refused reacquire is counted");
    check (domain->waitForReaderAdmissions (std::chrono::milliseconds (500)),
           "race: admissions become idle after the reader is refused");
    check (domain->admissionPendingSlots() == 0, "race: no reserved slot remains");
    check (domain->registerReaderThread ("late") == -1,
           "race: new registration after the fence must be refused");
    check (domain->reacquireReaderSlot (slot.load()) == false,
           "race: later reacquire must still be refused");
    check (domain->activeReaderCount() == 0, "race: no active reader after the race");

    {
        auto cap = convo::DrainCapability::makeForTest (true, true, true, true,
                                                        domain->epochAtFence(), 1, 1);
        check (domain->drainQueue (*queue, std::move (cap))
                   == convo::EpochDomain::DrainResult::Completed,
               "race: checked drain succeeds after quiescence");
    }
}

//==============================================================================
// 予約〜enter の間（depth 0・slot 予約済み）に shutdown が入る場合。
//   admission として数えられるため shutdown は待ち、enter 後は active reader と
//   して drain が拒否される。
//==============================================================================
void testReservedNotEntered()
{
    auto domain = std::make_unique<convo::EpochDomain> (convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown);

    std::atomic<int> slot { -1 };
    std::atomic<bool> registered { false };
    std::atomic<bool> released { false };
    std::atomic<bool> entered { false };

    std::thread reader ([&]
    {
        const int idx = domain->registerReaderThread ("reserved");
        slot.store (idx, std::memory_order_release);
        registered.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
        if (idx < 0)
            return;

        waitUntil (released);        // 予約だけ保持（admission 中・depth 0）
        domain->enterReader (idx);
        entered.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
    });

    waitUntil (registered);
    check (slot.load() >= 0, "reserved: registration");
    check (domain->admissionPendingSlots() == 1u, "reserved: reservation is an admission");

    domain->engageShutdownReaderFence();
    domain->closeReaderRegistration();

    check (! domain->waitForReaderAdmissions (std::chrono::milliseconds (100)),
           "reserved: shutdown must wait for the reservation");
    check (domain->activeReaderCount() == 0, "reserved: reserved slot is not active");
    check (domain->closePublishersAndWaitIdle (std::chrono::milliseconds (50)),
           "reserved: publishers must become idle");

    auto queue = domain->borrow();
    check (queue != nullptr, "reserved: borrow");
    if (queue == nullptr)
    {
        released.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
        reader.join();
        return;
    }

    {
        auto cap = convo::DrainCapability::makeForTest (true, true, true, true,
                                                        domain->epochAtFence(), 1, 1);
        check (domain->drainQueue (*queue, std::move (cap))
                   == convo::EpochDomain::DrainResult::ReadersNotQuiescent,
               "reserved: checked drain must fail while a reservation is open");
    }

    released.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
    waitUntil (entered);

    check (domain->waitForReaderAdmissions (std::chrono::milliseconds (500)),
           "reserved: admission ends at enterReader");
    check (domain->admissionPendingSlots() == 0, "reserved: reservation flag cleared");
    check (domain->activeReaderCount() == 1, "reserved: entered reader is active");

    {
        auto cap = convo::DrainCapability::makeForTest (true, true, true, true,
                                                        domain->epochAtFence(), 1, 1);
        check (domain->drainQueue (*queue, std::move (cap))
                   == convo::EpochDomain::DrainResult::ReadersNotQuiescent,
               "reserved: checked drain must fail while the reader is active");
    }

    domain->exitReader (slot.load());
    reader.join();

    {
        auto cap = convo::DrainCapability::makeForTest (true, true, true, true,
                                                        domain->epochAtFence(), 1, 1);
        check (domain->drainQueue (*queue, std::move (cap))
                   == convo::EpochDomain::DrainResult::Completed,
               "reserved: checked drain succeeds after the reader exits");
    }
}

void testDrainContract()
{
    auto domain = std::make_unique<convo::EpochDomain> (convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown);
    auto queue = domain->borrow();
    check (queue != nullptr, "drain: borrow");

    if (! queue)
        return;

    // 非空 queue で deleter の exactly-once を確認する。
    static int sentinel = 0;
    g_deleted.store (0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    check (domain->enqueueRetire (&sentinel, countingDeleter, domain->currentEpoch()),
           "drain: enqueue sentinel");

    // (1) reader 登録が開いたまま → ReadersNotQuiescent（drain しない・保持）。
    {
        auto cap = convo::DrainCapability::makeForTest (true, true, true, true,
                                                        domain->currentEpoch(), 1, 1);
        const auto r = domain->drainQueue (*queue, std::move (cap));
        check (r == convo::EpochDomain::DrainResult::ReadersNotQuiescent,
               "drain: open reader registration must be rejected");
        check (g_deleted.load() == 0, "drain: rejected drain must not run the deleter");
        check (queue->sizeApprox() == 1u, "drain: rejected drain must retain the entry");
    }

    // (2) fence + 登録遮断 + gate 閉鎖（idle 確認）→ Completed（deleter 1 回）。
    domain->engageShutdownReaderFence();
    domain->closeReaderRegistration();
    check (domain->closePublishersAndWaitIdle (std::chrono::milliseconds (50)),
           "drain: publishers must become idle");
    {
        auto cap = convo::DrainCapability::makeForTest (true, true, true, true,
                                                        domain->epochAtFence(), 1, 1);
        const auto r = domain->drainQueue (*queue, std::move (cap));
        check (r == convo::EpochDomain::DrainResult::Completed,
               "drain: quiescent state must complete");
        check (g_deleted.load() == 1, "drain: deleter must run exactly once");
        check (queue->sizeApprox() == 0u, "drain: queue must be empty after the drain");
    }

    // (3) capability の前提フラグが欠ける → CapabilityInvalid。
    {
        auto cap = convo::DrainCapability::makeForTest (false, true, true, true,
                                                        domain->epochAtFence(), 1, 1);
        const auto r = domain->drainQueue (*queue, std::move (cap));
        check (r == convo::EpochDomain::DrainResult::CapabilityInvalid,
               "drain: missing producers-joined flag must be rejected");
    }

    // (4) epoch 不一致 → ReadersNotQuiescent。
    {
        auto cap = convo::DrainCapability::makeForTest (true, true, true, true,
                                                        domain->epochAtFence() + 1000, 1, 1);
        const auto r = domain->drainQueue (*queue, std::move (cap));
        check (r == convo::EpochDomain::DrainResult::ReadersNotQuiescent,
               "drain: epoch mismatch must be rejected");
    }

    // (5) capability は single-use。
    {
        auto cap = convo::DrainCapability::makeForTest (true, true, true, true,
                                                        domain->epochAtFence(), 1, 1);
        check (cap.consume(), "drain: first consume");
        check (! cap.consume(), "drain: second consume must fail");
    }

    // (6) 二重 consume の capability では drain しない（AlreadyConsumed）。
    {
        auto cap = convo::DrainCapability::makeForTest (true, true, true, true,
                                                        domain->epochAtFence(), 1, 1);
        check (cap.consume(), "drain: consume before reuse");
        const auto r = domain->drainQueue (*queue, std::move (cap));
        check (r == convo::EpochDomain::DrainResult::AlreadyConsumed,
               "drain: reused capability must be rejected");
    }
}

void testQuarantine()
{
    auto domain = std::make_unique<convo::EpochDomain> (convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown);
    auto local = domain->borrow();
    check (local != nullptr, "quarantine: borrow");

    if (! local)
        return;

    static int sentinel = 0;
    g_deleted.store (0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    check (domain->enqueueRetire (&sentinel, countingDeleter, domain->currentEpoch()),
           "quarantine: enqueue sentinel");

    const auto countBefore = convo::EpochDomain::quarantineCount();
    const auto pendingBefore = convo::EpochDomain::quarantinePendingEntries();
    const auto pendingInQueue = static_cast<std::uint64_t> (local->sizeApprox());
    check (pendingInQueue == 1u, "quarantine: queue must hold one entry");
    auto* raw = local.get();

    const auto first = domain->quarantineQueue (local);
    const auto second = domain->quarantineQueue (local);
    local.reset();

    check (first == convo::EpochDomain::QuarantineResult::Registered,
           "quarantine: first registration");
    check (second == convo::EpochDomain::QuarantineResult::AlreadyRegistered,
           "quarantine: second registration must be refused");
    check (convo::EpochDomain::quarantineCount() == countBefore + 1u,
           "quarantine: count must increase once");
    check (convo::EpochDomain::quarantinePendingEntries() == pendingBefore + pendingInQueue,
           "quarantine: pending entries must accumulate once");
    check (convo::EpochDomain::quarantinePendingEntries() > pendingBefore,
           "quarantine: pending increment must not be vacuous");
    check (g_deleted.load() == 0, "quarantine: deleter must not run");
    check (raw != nullptr && raw->sizeApprox() == static_cast<std::uint32_t> (pendingInQueue),
           "quarantine: queue must be retained by the self reference");
}

} // namespace

//==============================================================================
// ★ WORK113 R1 (2026-11-19 Owner 承認): exit 処理中（depth==0・provider 後処理が残る）に
//   drainQueue が静止を主張しないこと。
//   seam で depth デクリメント直後に止め、同じ構成で exit 完了後に
//   Completed になることを対照に取る（他の条件が成立していることの証拠）。
//==============================================================================
void testExitInProgressBlocksDrain()
{
    auto domain = std::make_unique<convo::EpochDomain> (convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown);

    struct Seam
    {
        std::atomic<bool> fired { false };      // 1 回だけ止めるためのフラグ
        std::atomic<bool> reached { false };
        std::atomic<bool> release { false };
    };

    static Seam seam;
    seam.fired.store (false);
    seam.reached.store (false);
    seam.release.store (false);

    convo::EpochDomain::setReaderExitSeam ([] (void* p) noexcept
    {
        // ★ 1 回だけ止める（他の exit を止めない）。
        //   seam 自体はここで解除しない（解除は join 後）。
        auto* s2 = static_cast<Seam*> (p);
        if (s2 == nullptr)
            return;
        bool expected = false;
        if (! s2->fired.compare_exchange_strong (expected, true))
            return;
        s2->reached.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
        while (! s2->release.load (std::memory_order_acquire))
            std::this_thread::yield();
    }, &seam);

    std::atomic<int> slot { -1 };
    std::atomic<bool> entered { false };
    std::atomic<bool> goExit { false };

    std::thread reader ([&]
    {
        const int idx = domain->registerReaderThread ("exit-window");
        slot.store (idx, std::memory_order_release);
        if (idx < 0)
            return;
        domain->enterReader (idx);
        entered.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
        waitUntil (goExit);
        domain->exitReader (idx);          // seam で depth デクリメント直後に止まる
    });

    // タイムアウト時は worker を解放して join し、seam を外してから FAIL にする。
    auto cleanupWorker = [&]
    {
        goExit.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
        seam.release.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
        if (reader.joinable())
            reader.join();
        // ★ 解除は join の後。実行中の exitReader が旧 fn と nullptr の ctx を
        //   組み合わせて呼ぶ経路を作らない。
        convo::EpochDomain::setReaderExitSeam (nullptr, nullptr);
    };

    if (! waitUntilBounded (entered, std::chrono::milliseconds (2000)))
    {
        check (false, "exit-window: reader did not enter (registration failed or enter stalled)");
        cleanupWorker();
        return;
    }
    check (slot.load() >= 0, "exit-window: registration");

    // shutdown 側の前提を整える（fence・登録閉鎖・bublisher idle）。
    domain->engageShutdownReaderFence();
    domain->closeReaderRegistration();
    // ★ CI の一時停止で 50 ms の期限が過ぎると、publisher がいなくても
    //   false になり、epochAtFence() が無効なまま drain を試してしまう。
    //   reader 側の確認と同じ 2 秒の予算を与え、失敗したら drain を試さずに後片付ける。
    const bool publishersIdle =
        domain->closePublishersAndWaitIdle (std::chrono::milliseconds (2000));
    check (publishersIdle, "exit-window: publishers must become idle");
    if (! publishersIdle)
    {
        cleanupWorker();
        return;
    }

    auto queue = domain->borrow();
    check (queue != nullptr, "exit-window: borrow");
    if (queue == nullptr)
    {
        cleanupWorker();
        return;
    }

    // 拒否が「entry を処理しない」ことの証拠として sentinel を 1 件積む。
    static int sentinel = 0;
    g_deleted.store (0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    check (domain->enqueueRetire (&sentinel, countingDeleter, domain->currentEpoch()),
           "exit-window: enqueue sentinel");

    goExit.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
    if (! waitUntilBounded (seam.reached, std::chrono::milliseconds (2000)))
    {
        check (false, "exit-window: exit seam was not reached");
        cleanupWorker();
        return;
    }

    // 窓の観測：depth は 0、活動数は 1 以上、admission は idle。
    const std::uint32_t depthReaders = domain->activeDepthReaderCount();
    const std::uint32_t activity = domain->activeReaderCount();
    check (depthReaders == 0u, "exit-window: depth is 0 inside the window");
    check (activity >= 1u, "exit-window: exit-in-progress is counted as activity");
    check (domain->readerAdmissionsActive() == 0u, "exit-window: admission active is 0");
    check (domain->admissionPendingSlots() == 0u, "exit-window: no pending admission slot");

    {
        auto cap = convo::DrainCapability::makeForTest (true, true, true, true,
                                                        domain->epochAtFence(), 1, 1);
        check (domain->drainQueue (*queue, std::move (cap))
                   == convo::EpochDomain::DrainResult::ReadersNotQuiescent,
               "exit-window: checked drain must fail while exit is in progress");
    }
    check (g_deleted.load() == 0, "exit-window: rejected drain must not run the deleter");
    check (queue->sizeApprox() == 1u, "exit-window: rejected drain must retain the entry");

    // exit を完了させる。同じ構成で Completed になれば、上の拒否は exit カウンタが理由だ。
    seam.release.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
    reader.join();
    convo::EpochDomain::setReaderExitSeam (nullptr, nullptr);

    check (domain->activeReaderCount() == 0u, "exit-window: activity returns to 0 after exit");

    {
        auto cap = convo::DrainCapability::makeForTest (true, true, true, true,
                                                        domain->epochAtFence(), 1, 1);
        check (domain->drainQueue (*queue, std::move (cap))
                   == convo::EpochDomain::DrainResult::Completed,
               "exit-window: checked drain succeeds after exit completes");
    }
    check (g_deleted.load() == 1, "exit-window: completed drain must run the deleter exactly once");
    check (queue->sizeApprox() == 0u, "exit-window: queue must be empty after the drain");
}

//==============================================================================
// ★ WORK113 R1: exitReader の早期 return（previousDepth == 0 / > 1）でも
//   exit カウンタが元に戻ること。
//   差（activeReaderCount - activeDepthReaderCount）が exit 実行中の件数である。
//==============================================================================
void testExitCounterRestoredOnEarlyReturns()
{
    auto domain = std::make_unique<convo::EpochDomain> (convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown);

    const int idx = domain->registerReaderThread ("early-return");
    check (idx >= 0, "early: registration");
    if (idx < 0)
        return;

    auto exitInProgress = [&domain]() -> std::uint32_t
    {
        const std::uint32_t activity = domain->activeReaderCount();
        const std::uint32_t depthReaders = domain->activeDepthReaderCount();
        return activity > depthReaders ? activity - depthReaders : 0u;
    };

    domain->enterReader (idx);          // depth 1
    domain->enterReader (idx);          // depth 2（ネスト）
    check (domain->activeDepthReaderCount() == 1u, "early: nested reader counts once");

    domain->exitReader (idx);           // previousDepth == 2 → 早期 return
    check (exitInProgress() == 0u, "early: nested exit restores the counter");
    check (domain->activeReaderCount() == 1u, "early: nested exit keeps activity 1");

    domain->exitReader (idx);           // previousDepth == 1 → 通常終了
    check (exitInProgress() == 0u, "early: outer exit restores the counter");
    check (domain->activeReaderCount() == 0u, "early: activity returns to 0");

    domain->exitReader (idx);           // previousDepth == 0 → underflow の早期 return
    check (exitInProgress() == 0u, "early: underflow exit restores the counter");
    check (domain->activeReaderCount() == 0u, "early: activity stays 0 after underflow");
}

int main()
{
    testPublishGate();

    {
        auto domain = std::make_unique<convo::EpochDomain> (convo::RetireDomainId::Unknown);
        testReaderFence (*domain);
    }

    testAdmissionRace();
    testReservedNotEntered();
    testExitInProgressBlocksDrain();
    testExitCounterRestoredOnEarlyReturns();
    testRetireDrainExclusion();
    testDrainContract();
    testQuarantine();

    if (g_failures != 0)
    {
        std::fprintf (stderr, "[drain-test] %d failure(s)\n", g_failures);
        return 1;
    }

    std::printf ("[drain-test] ALL PASS (gate / fence / admission / drain / capability / quarantine)\n");
    return 0;
}

//==============================================================================
// DSPHandleTableTests.cpp — work88 (FUTURE-6 監査) HandleTable 単体テスト
//
// テスト対象: DSPHandleTable (src/audioengine/DSPHandleTable.h) — open addressing + tombstone
//
// ■ 測定項目（監査指摘: クラスタ断絶リグレッション防止）:
//   1. insert → find の基本（単一/複数エントリ）
//   2. erase 後に同じバケットの後続エントリが find できる（クラスタ断絶なし = tombstone 有効性）
//   3. erase → insert（tombstone 再利用）後に全エントリ find 可能
//   4. findAndEraseByHandle / eraseByHandle が key を返しつつ削除できる
//   5. 重複登録なし（find で既存 key を検出し、同一 key の二重 insert で size 不変）
//
// ■ ビルド:
//   CMakeLists.txt に以下を追加（既存テスト群と同じパターン）:
//     add_executable(DSPHandleTableTests
//         src/tests/DSPHandleTableTests.cpp
//     )
//     target_compile_features(DSPHandleTableTests PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
//     target_compile_options(DSPHandleTableTests PRIVATE /EHsc /utf-8)
//     target_include_directories(DSPHandleTableTests PRIVATE
//         ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
//         ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
//         ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/audioengine
//         ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/core
//     )
//     add_test(NAME DSPHandleTableTests COMMAND DSPHandleTableTests)
//
//==============================================================================

#include "audioengine/DSPHandleTable.h"  // テスト対象本体（ヘッダオンリー）

#include <cstdint>
#include <iostream>
#include <mutex>
#include <vector>

namespace {

int g_testCount = 0;
int g_failCount = 0;
std::mutex g_ioMutex;

void testPass(const char* name)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_ioMutex);
    std::cout << "  PASS: " << name << std::endl;
    ++g_testCount;
}

void testFail(const char* name, const char* detail = nullptr)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_ioMutex);
    std::cout << "  FAIL: " << name;
    if (detail) std::cout << " -- " << detail;
    std::cout << std::endl;
    ++g_testCount;
    ++g_failCount;
}

void checkTrue(const char* name, bool condition)
{
    if (condition) testPass(name);
    else testFail(name, "condition was false");
}

// テスト用のダミーキー（実ポインタに見せかけた重複しないアドレス値）
inline void* makeKey(std::uintptr_t v) { return reinterpret_cast<void*>(v); }

// 1. 基本 insert/find
bool testBasicInsertFind()
{
    convo::isr::DSPHandleTable table;
    convo::isr::DSPHandle h1{1, 1};
    convo::isr::DSPHandle h2{2, 2};

    if (!table.insert(makeKey(0x1000), h1))
        return false;
    if (!table.insert(makeKey(0x2000), h2))
        return false;
    if (table.size() != 2)
        return false;

    convo::isr::DSPHandle out;
    if (!table.find(makeKey(0x1000), out) || out.slot != 1)
        return false;
    if (!table.find(makeKey(0x2000), out) || out.slot != 2)
        return false;
    if (table.find(makeKey(0x3000), out))
        return false;  // 存在しない key
    return true;
}

// 2. ★ クラスタ断絶リグレッション: 多数 insert → 一部 erase → 残り全部 find 可能
//   （erase を tombstone 化しないと、同じバケットの後続エントリが find 不能になる）
bool testEraseDoesNotBreakCluster()
{
    convo::isr::DSPHandleTable table;
    constexpr int kCount = 200;  // 512 容量に対し 200 挿入（負荷率 0.39 → 衝突発生）

    // 挿入（連続アドレス値 → ハッシュ衝突が発生しやすい）
    for (int i = 1; i <= kCount; ++i)
    {
        convo::isr::DSPHandle h{static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i), static_cast<std::uint64_t>(i)};
        if (!table.insert(makeKey(static_cast<std::uintptr_t>(0x1000 + i * 64)), h))
            return false;
    }
    if (table.size() != static_cast<std::uint32_t>(kCount))
        return false;

    // 半分を削除
    for (int i = 1; i <= kCount; i += 2)
    {
        if (!table.erase(makeKey(static_cast<std::uintptr_t>(0x1000 + i * 64))))
            return false;
    }
    if (table.size() != static_cast<std::uint32_t>(kCount / 2))
        return false;

    // 残り全部が find 可能（tombstone 化によりクラスタ断絶なし）
    for (int i = 2; i <= kCount; i += 2)
    {
        convo::isr::DSPHandle out;
        if (!table.find(makeKey(static_cast<std::uintptr_t>(0x1000 + i * 64)), out))
            return false;  // ★ クラスタ断絶バグがあればここで失敗
        if (out.slot != static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i))
            return false;
    }
    // 削除済みは find されない
    for (int i = 1; i <= kCount; i += 2)
    {
        convo::isr::DSPHandle out;
        if (table.find(makeKey(static_cast<std::uintptr_t>(0x1000 + i * 64)), out))
            return false;
    }
    return true;
}

// 3. erase → insert（tombstone 再利用）後に全エントリ find 可能
bool testTombstoneReuse()
{
    convo::isr::DSPHandleTable table;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 100; ++i)
    {
        convo::isr::DSPHandle h{static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i), static_cast<std::uint64_t>(i)};
        table.insert(makeKey(static_cast<std::uintptr_t>(0x5000 + i * 32)), h);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= 50; ++i)
        table.erase(makeKey(static_cast<std::uintptr_t>(0x5000 + i * 32)));

    // tombstone を再利用して新しい key を挿入
    for (int i = 1; i <= 50; ++i)
    {
        convo::isr::DSPHandle h{static_cast<std::uint32_t>(1000 + i), static_cast<std::uint64_t>(1000 + i)};
        if (!table.insert(makeKey(static_cast<std::uintptr_t>(0x9000 + i * 32)), h))
            return false;
    }
    if (table.size() != 100)
        return false;

    // 旧エントリ（51..100）と新エントリ（1001..1050）が全部 find 可能
    for (int i = 51; i <= 100; ++i)
    {
        convo::isr::DSPHandle out;
        if (!table.find(makeKey(static_cast<std::uintptr_t>(0x5000 + i * 32)), out))
            return false;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= 50; ++i)
    {
        convo::isr::DSPHandle out;
        if (!table.find(makeKey(static_cast<std::uintptr_t>(0x9000 + i * 32)), out))
            return false;
        if (out.slot != static_cast<std::uint32_t>(1000 + i))
            return false;
    }
    return true;
}

// 4. findAndEraseByHandle / eraseByHandle
bool testFindAndEraseByHandle()
{
    convo::isr::DSPHandleTable table;
    convo::isr::DSPHandle h1{7, 7};
    convo::isr::DSPHandle h2{8, 8};
    table.insert(makeKey(0xA000), h1);
    table.insert(makeKey(0xB000), h2);

    void* key = nullptr;
    if (!table.findAndEraseByHandle(h1, key))
        return false;
    if (key != makeKey(0xA000))
        return false;  // key が正しく返る
    if (table.size() != 1)
        return false;

    // 残りの h2 は find 可能（クラスタ断絶なし）
    convo::isr::DSPHandle out;
    if (!table.find(makeKey(0xB000), out))
        return false;

    if (!table.eraseByHandle(h2))
        return false;
    if (table.size() != 0)
        return false;
    if (table.find(makeKey(0xB000), out))
        return false;
    return true;
}

// 5. 同一 key の二重 insert で重複登録しない
bool testNoDuplicateOnReinsert()
{
    convo::isr::DSPHandleTable table;
    convo::isr::DSPHandle h{3, 3};
    table.insert(makeKey(0xCC00), h);
    // 同じ key を再 insert（値更新）→ size 不変
    convo::isr::DSPHandle h2{4, 4};
    table.insert(makeKey(0xCC00), h2);
    if (table.size() != 1)
        return false;
    convo::isr::DSPHandle out;
    if (!table.find(makeKey(0xCC00), out))
        return false;
    return out.slot == 4;  // 更新後の値が返る
}

} // anonymous namespace

//==============================================================================
// main
//==============================================================================
int main()
{
    std::cout << "DSPHandleTableTests" << std::endl;

    checkTrue("basic insert/find", testBasicInsertFind());
    checkTrue("erase does not break cluster (tombstone)", testEraseDoesNotBreakCluster());
    checkTrue("tombstone reuse", testTombstoneReuse());
    checkTrue("findAndEraseByHandle / eraseByHandle", testFindAndEraseByHandle());
    checkTrue("no duplicate on reinsert", testNoDuplicateOnReinsert());

    std::cout << "==========================================" << std::endl;
    std::cout << "Tests: " << g_testCount << ", Failures: " << g_failCount << std::endl;
    if (g_failCount == 0)
        std::cout << "ALL TESTS PASSED" << std::endl;
    else
        std::cout << "SOME TESTS FAILED" << std::endl;

    return (g_failCount == 0) ? 0 : 1;
}
